//go:build windows

package windows

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"slices"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf16"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
	win "golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

const parentNotifyFilter uint32 = 0x1f
const parentNotifyLimit = 64 << 10

type parentNotifyItem struct {
	Action uint32
	Name   string
}
type parentNotifyKey struct{ Connection, MessageID uint64 }
type parentNotifyRequest struct {
	Key       parentNotifyKey
	Session   uint64
	FileID    string
	Filter    uint32
	Recursive bool
	Capacity  uint32
	At        time.Time
}
type parentNotifyResult struct {
	Request parentNotifyRequest
	Items   []parentNotifyItem
	At      time.Time
}

var parentNotifyRegistry struct {
	sync.Mutex
	requests   map[parentNotifyKey]parentNotifyRequest
	results    []parentNotifyResult
	incomplete bool
	sequence   uint64
	observed   []parentNotifyObservation
}

type parentNotifyObservation struct {
	Sequence uint64
	Record   cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
}

func cacheGateParentWireObserved(record cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
	if record.Command != wire.ChangeNotify || !record.Response {
		return
	}
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	parentNotifyRegistry.sequence++
	if len(parentNotifyRegistry.observed) >= 64 {
		parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete = true
		return
	}
	parentNotifyRegistry.observed = append(parentNotifyRegistry.observed, parentNotifyObservation{parentNotifyRegistry.sequence, record})
}
func parentObservationBoundary() uint64 {
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	parentNotifyRegistry.sequence++
	return parentNotifyRegistry.sequence
}
func parentObservationSnapshot() []parentNotifyObservation {
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	return append([]parentNotifyObservation(nil), parentNotifyRegistry.observed...)
}

func parentNotifyDecode(data []byte) ([]parentNotifyItem, error) {
	if len(data) == 0 || len(data) > parentNotifyLimit {
		return nil, errors.New("empty or excessive notification buffer")
	}
	var items []parentNotifyItem
	for {
		if len(items) >= 256 || len(data) < 12 {
			return nil, errors.New("notification count or header bound")
		}
		next, action, length := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data), binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[4:]), binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[8:])
		if action < 1 || action > 5 || length == 0 || length > 4096 || length&1 != 0 || uint64(length)+12 > uint64(len(data)) {
			return nil, errors.New("notification action or name length")
		}
		end := 12 + int(length)
		if next != 0 && (next&3 != 0 || uint64(next) < uint64(end) || uint64(next)+12 > uint64(len(data))) {
			return nil, errors.New("overlapping or truncated notification chain")
		}
		words := make([]uint16, length/2)
		for i := range words {
			words[i] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[12+2*i:])
		}
		for i := 0; i < len(words); i++ {
			c := words[i]
			if c == 0 || c >= 0xdc00 && c <= 0xdfff {
				return nil, errors.New("invalid notification UTF-16")
			}
			if c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdbff {
				if i+1 == len(words) || words[i+1] < 0xdc00 || words[i+1] > 0xdfff {
					return nil, errors.New("unpaired notification surrogate")
				}
				i++
			}
		}
		items = append(items, parentNotifyItem{Action: action, Name: string(utf16.Decode(words))})
		if next == 0 {
			if len(data)-end > 3 {
				return nil, errors.New("unaccounted notification bytes")
			}
			for _, b := range data[end:] {
				if b != 0 {
					return nil, errors.New("nonzero notification padding")
				}
			}
			return items, nil
		}
		for _, b := range data[end:next] {
			if b != 0 {
				return nil, errors.New("nonzero notification entry padding")
			}
		}
		data = data[next:]
	}
}

func cacheGateParentNotifyRequest(packet []byte, r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	if len(packet) < wire.HeaderSize+32 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(packet[wire.HeaderSize:]) != 32 {
		return false
	}
	body := packet[wire.HeaderSize:]
	flags := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(body[2:])
	capacity := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(body[4:])
	if flags&^uint16(1) != 0 || capacity == 0 || capacity > parentNotifyLimit || r.Connection == 0 {
		return false
	}
	r.FileID = hex.EncodeToString(body[8:24])
	request := parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{r.Connection, r.MessageID}, Session: r.SessionID, FileID: r.FileID, Filter: binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(body[24:]), Recursive: flags&1 != 0, Capacity: capacity, At: time.Now()}
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	if parentNotifyRegistry.requests == nil {
		parentNotifyRegistry.requests = make(map[parentNotifyKey]parentNotifyRequest)
	}
	if len(parentNotifyRegistry.requests) >= 32 {
		parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete = true
		return false
	}
	if _, ok := parentNotifyRegistry.requests[request.Key]; ok {
		parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete = true
		return false
	}
	parentNotifyRegistry.requests[request.Key] = request
	return true
}
func cacheGateParentNotifyResponse(packet []byte, r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	if len(packet) < wire.HeaderSize+8 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(packet[wire.HeaderSize:]) != 9 {
		return false
	}
	body := packet[wire.HeaderSize:]
	offset, length := uint32(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(body[2:])), binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(body[4:])
	data, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, offset, length, wire.HeaderSize+8)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	items, err := parentNotifyDecode(data)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	request, ok := parentNotifyRegistry.requests[parentNotifyKey{r.Connection, r.MessageID}]
	if !ok || request.Session != r.SessionID || length > request.Capacity || len(parentNotifyRegistry.results) >= 32 {
		parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete = true
		return false
	}
	parentNotifyRegistry.results = append(parentNotifyRegistry.results, parentNotifyResult{Request: request, Items: items, At: time.Now()})
	return true
}
func parentNotifySnapshot() ([]parentNotifyRequest, []parentNotifyResult, bool) {
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	requests := make([]parentNotifyRequest, 0, len(parentNotifyRegistry.requests))
	for _, r := range parentNotifyRegistry.requests {
		requests = append(requests, r)
	}
	results := append([]parentNotifyResult(nil), parentNotifyRegistry.results...)
	return requests, results, parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete
}
func parentNotifyReset() {
	parentNotifyRegistry.Lock()
	defer parentNotifyRegistry.Unlock()
	parentNotifyRegistry.requests = make(map[parentNotifyKey]parentNotifyRequest)
	parentNotifyRegistry.results = nil
	parentNotifyRegistry.incomplete = false
	parentNotifyRegistry.sequence = 0
	parentNotifyRegistry.observed = nil
}

type parentNativeWatch struct {
	file    *nativeHandle
	event   win.Handle
	overlap win.Overlapped
	buffer  []byte
	done    bool
}

type parentNativeCompletion struct {
	Drained   bool
	Count     uint32
	ErrorCode uint32
	Error     string
	Completed time.Time
	Items     []parentNotifyItem
}

type parentNotifyOutcome struct {
	Mode     string
	Pending  parentNotifyRequest
	Native   parentNativeCompletion
	Terminal cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
	Detail   *parentNotifyResult
}

type parentNotifyReadiness struct {
	Pending             parentNotifyRequest
	Checked             time.Time
	EndSequence         uint64
	ObservationSequence uint64
	NativePending       bool
	TerminalObserved    bool
}

const parentDetail = "detail"
const parentVerifiedRescan = "verified_rescan"
const parentStatusNotifyEnum uint32 = 0x10c
const parentErrorNotifyEnum uint32 = 1022

func parentNotifyTerminal(current parentNotifyRequest, records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) (cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, bool, error) {
	var terminal cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
	pending, finals := 0, 0
	for _, r := range records {
		if !r.Response || r.Command != wire.ChangeNotify || r.Connection != current.Key.Connection || r.MessageID != current.Key.MessageID {
			continue
		}
		if r.SessionID != current.Session || r.FileID != current.FileID || r.Incomplete != "" {
			return terminal, false, errors.New("notification response changed request identity")
		}
		if r.Status == 0x103 {
			pending++
		} else {
			finals++
			terminal = r
		}
	}
	if pending > 1 || finals > 1 {
		return terminal, false, errors.New("duplicate notification response")
	}
	if pending == 0 || finals == 0 {
		return terminal, false, nil
	}
	return terminal, true, nil
}

func parentMatchNotifyOutcome(current parentNotifyRequest, native parentNativeCompletion, records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, details []parentNotifyResult) (parentNotifyOutcome, bool, error) {
	out := parentNotifyOutcome{Pending: current, Native: native}
	if !native.Drained || native.Completed.IsZero() || current.Key.Connection == 0 || current.Session == 0 || current.FileID == "" || current.Filter != parentNotifyFilter || !current.Recursive || current.Capacity == 0 || native.Count > current.Capacity || current.Capacity > parentNotifyLimit {
		return out, false, errors.New("notification completion or watcher is invalid")
	}
	terminal, ready, err := parentNotifyTerminal(current, records)
	if err != nil || !ready {
		return out, false, err
	}
	out.Terminal = terminal
	if terminal.Status == parentStatusNotifyEnum {
		if native.Count != 0 || len(native.Items) != 0 || !(native.ErrorCode == 0 && native.Error == "" || native.ErrorCode == parentErrorNotifyEnum && native.Error != "") {
			return out, false, errors.New("wire rescan has no matching native completion")
		}
		out.Mode = parentVerifiedRescan
		return out, true, nil
	}
	if terminal.Status != 0 || native.Count == 0 || native.ErrorCode != 0 || native.Error != "" || len(native.Items) == 0 {
		return out, false, errors.New("notification is neither detail nor verified rescan")
	}
	for _, detail := range details {
		if detail.Request.Key != current.Key {
			continue
		}
		if out.Detail != nil || detail.Request != current || !slices.Equal(detail.Items, native.Items) {
			return out, false, errors.New("native and wire notification detail disagree")
		}
		copy := detail
		out.Detail = &copy
	}
	if out.Detail == nil {
		return out, false, nil
	}
	out.Mode = parentDetail
	return out, true, nil
}

func parentAwaitNotifyOutcome(current parentNotifyRequest, native parentNativeCompletion, deadline time.Time) (parentNotifyOutcome, error) {
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		_, details, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
		if incomplete || bad {
			return parentNotifyOutcome{}, errors.New("notification outcome trace is incomplete")
		}
		out, ready, err := parentMatchNotifyOutcome(current, native, records, details)
		if err != nil || ready {
			return out, err
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
	return parentNotifyOutcome{}, errors.New("notification outcome exceeded absolute deadline")
}

func parentWatchStart(t *testing.T, file *nativeHandle) *parentNativeWatch {
	t.Helper()
	event, err := win.CreateEvent(nil, 1, 0, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	w := &parentNativeWatch{file: file, event: event, buffer: make([]byte, parentNotifyLimit)}
	w.overlap.HEvent = event
	err = win.ReadDirectoryChanges(file.value, &w.buffer[0], uint32(len(w.buffer)), true, parentNotifyFilter, nil, &w.overlap, 0)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
		_ = win.CloseHandle(event)
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if !w.done {
			err := win.CancelIoEx(file.value, &w.overlap)
			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_NOT_FOUND) {
				t.Error("cancel owned parent watcher:", err)
			}
			var count uint32
			err = win.GetOverlappedResult(file.value, &w.overlap, &count, true)
			cacheGateObserve("parent_notify_cleanup_drain", map[string]any{"count": count, "error": fmt.Sprint(err)})
			if !parentCleanupDrained(err) {
				t.Error("drain owned parent watcher:", err)
			}
			w.done = true
		}
		if err := win.CloseHandle(w.event); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		runtime.KeepAlive(w)
	})
	return w
}
func parentCleanupDrained(err error) bool {
	return err == nil || errors.Is(err, syscall.Errno(995)) || errors.Is(err, syscall.Errno(parentErrorNotifyEnum))
}

func (w *parentNativeWatch) complete(deadline time.Time) ([]parentNotifyItem, error) {
	completion, err := w.completeNative(deadline)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(completion.Items) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("empty notification detail")
	}
	return completion.Items, nil
}
func (w *parentNativeWatch) completeNative(deadline time.Time) (parentNativeCompletion, error) {
	var result parentNativeCompletion
	remaining := time.Until(deadline)
	if remaining <= 0 {
		return result, errors.New("notification deadline exhausted")
	}
	timeout := uint32(remaining / time.Millisecond)
	status, err := win.WaitForSingleObject(w.event, timeout)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if status != uint32(win.WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
		return result, fmt.Errorf("notification wait status %d", status)
	}
	var count uint32
	err = win.GetOverlappedResult(w.file.value, &w.overlap, &count, false)
	result.Count, result.Completed = count, time.Now()
	if err != nil {
		result.Error = err.Error()
		var code syscall.Errno
		if errors.As(err, &code) {
			result.ErrorCode = uint32(code)
		}
	}
	if errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_IO_INCOMPLETE) {
		return result, err
	}
	w.done = true
	result.Drained = true
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if count > uint32(len(w.buffer)) {
		return result, errors.New("native notification overflow")
	}
	if count != 0 {
		result.Items, err = parentNotifyDecode(w.buffer[:count])
	}
	return result, err
}
func parentAwaitPending(t *testing.T) parentNotifyRequest {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
	for {
		requests, _, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
		records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		if bad || incomplete {
			t.Fatal("incomplete notification request trace")
		}
		for _, request := range requests {
			if request.Filter != parentNotifyFilter || !request.Recursive {
				t.Fatal("parent watcher used incorrect filter or recursion")
			}
			for _, r := range records {
				if r.Response && r.Command == wire.ChangeNotify && r.Connection == request.Key.Connection && r.MessageID == request.Key.MessageID && r.Status == 0x103 {
					finished := false
					for _, final := range records {
						if final.Response && final.Command == wire.ChangeNotify && final.Connection == request.Key.Connection && final.MessageID == request.Key.MessageID && final.Status != 0x103 {
							finished = true
						}
					}
					if finished {
						t.Fatal("watch completed before the measured mutation")
					}
					return request
				}
			}
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("parent watch never reached actual SMB STATUS_PENDING")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

type parentInvalidationQualification struct {
	Watched                            bool
	Pending                            bool
	NativeModified                     bool
	WireModified                       bool
	SameConnection                     bool
	Quiet                              bool
	FreshTargetTraffic                 bool
	TraceComplete                      bool
	ACK, FirstExposure, EarliestExpiry time.Time
	WriteStarted, NotifyCompleted      time.Time
	Native                             cacheGatePositiveValue
	Initial, Expected                  storage.Attr
}

func parentInvalidationClassify(q parentInvalidationQualification) (string, bool) {
	return parentSizeClassify(q, 257, 769)
}
func parentSizeClassify(q parentInvalidationQualification, oldSize, newSize int64) (string, bool) {
	if !q.TraceComplete || !q.SameConnection || !q.Quiet || q.Native.Error != "" || q.Native.Started.Before(q.ACK) || q.Native.Completed.Before(q.Native.Started) || q.Native.Completed.After(q.ACK.Add(time.Second)) || !q.Native.Completed.Before(q.EarliestExpiry) || q.FirstExposure.IsZero() || q.FirstExposure.After(q.Native.Started) || q.Expected.ID != q.Initial.ID || q.Initial.Size != oldSize || q.Expected.Size != newSize || q.Expected.MetadataRevision <= q.Initial.MetadataRevision || q.Expected.ModTime.Equal(q.Initial.ModTime) {
		return "inconclusive", false
	}
	if q.Watched && (!q.Pending || !q.NativeModified || !q.WireModified || q.NotifyCompleted.Before(q.WriteStarted) || q.NotifyCompleted.After(q.Native.Started) || q.NotifyCompleted.IsZero()) {
		return "inconclusive", false
	}
	current := q.Native.Size == q.Expected.Size && q.Native.MTime == cacheGatePositiveTime(q.Expected.ModTime)
	old := q.Native.Size == q.Initial.Size && q.Native.MTime == cacheGatePositiveTime(q.Initial.ModTime)
	if !q.Watched {
		if old {
			return "control_old_first_sample_observation_only", false
		}
		if current {
			return "control_current_first_sample_observation_only", false
		}
		return "inconclusive", false
	}
	if current && q.FreshTargetTraffic {
		return "current_before_deadline", true
	}
	if old {
		return "stale_first_sample_observation_only", false
	}
	return "inconclusive", false
}
func parentHasModified(items []parentNotifyItem) bool {
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.Action == win.FILE_ACTION_MODIFIED && item.Name == `v\target` {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func parentConnectionProof(records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, request *parentNotifyRequest) (uint64, uint64, bool) {
	var connection, session uint64
	var childID, targetID string
	rootMatched := false
	for _, r := range records {
		if !r.Response || r.Command != wire.Create || r.Status != 0 {
			continue
		}
		if r.Name != "" && r.Name != "v" && r.Name != `v\target` {
			continue
		}
		if connection == 0 {
			connection, session = r.Connection, r.SessionID
		}
		if connection != r.Connection || session != r.SessionID {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		if r.Name == "" && request != nil && r.FileID == request.FileID {
			rootMatched = true
		}
		if r.Name == "v" {
			childID = r.FileID
		}
		if r.Name == `v\target` {
			targetID = r.FileID
		}
	}
	if connection == 0 || session == 0 || childID == "" || targetID == "" || targetID == childID {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	if request != nil && (request.Key.Connection != connection || request.Session != session || request.FileID == "" || request.FileID == childID || request.FileID == targetID || !rootMatched) {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	return connection, session, true
}

type parentNativeCall struct {
	API, Path                  string
	Started, Completed         time.Time
	BeginSequence, EndSequence uint64
	Selected                   *cacheGatePositiveValue
}

func parentSameObservation(a, b cacheGatePositiveValue) bool {
	if !a.Started.Equal(b.Started) || !a.Completed.Equal(b.Completed) {
		return false
	}
	a.Started, a.Completed = time.Time{}, time.Time{}
	b.Started, b.Completed = time.Time{}, time.Time{}
	return a == b
}

func parentHarnessQuiet(calls []parentNativeCall, boundary uint64, first cacheGatePositiveValue) bool {
	return parentHarnessOrdered(calls, boundary, first, false)
}
func parentHarnessOrdered(calls []parentNativeCall, boundary uint64, first cacheGatePositiveValue, replacement bool) bool {
	if boundary == 0 || len(calls) == 0 || len(calls) > 32 {
		return false
	}
	seen := map[uint64]bool{boundary: true}
	var selectedBegin, previousEnd uint64
	selected, waits, rearms, readiness := 0, 0, 0, 0
	var lastWatcherAPI string
	var postSelected []string
	for _, call := range calls {
		if call.BeginSequence == 0 || call.EndSequence <= call.BeginSequence || call.BeginSequence <= previousEnd || seen[call.BeginSequence] || seen[call.EndSequence] || call.Completed.Before(call.Started) {
			return false
		}
		seen[call.BeginSequence], seen[call.EndSequence] = true, true
		previousEnd = call.EndSequence
		if !replacement && call.API == "first-attributes" || replacement && call.API == "first-open" {
			selected++
			if call.BeginSequence <= boundary || call.Selected == nil || !parentSameObservation(*call.Selected, first) || call.Started.After(first.Started) || call.Completed.Before(first.Completed) {
				return false
			}
			selectedBegin = call.BeginSequence
			continue
		}
		if call.Selected != nil {
			return false
		}
		if replacement && call.API == "notify-readiness" {
			readiness++
			if call.BeginSequence <= boundary || lastWatcherAPI != "notify-rearm" || selected != 0 {
				return false
			}
			lastWatcherAPI = call.API
			continue
		}
		if replacement && call.API == "notify-rearm" {
			rearms++
			if call.BeginSequence <= boundary || lastWatcherAPI != "notify-wait" || selected != 0 {
				return false
			}
			lastWatcherAPI = call.API
			continue
		}
		if replacement && selected == 1 && (call.API == "new-identity" || call.API == "old-identity" || call.API == "old-read" || call.API == "new-read") {
			postSelected = append(postSelected, call.API)
			continue
		}
		if call.API == "notify-wait" {
			waits++
			if replacement && (selected != 0 || waits > 1 && lastWatcherAPI != "notify-rearm" && lastWatcherAPI != "notify-readiness") {
				return false
			}
			lastWatcherAPI = call.API
			if call.BeginSequence <= boundary {
				return false
			}
			continue
		}
		if call.EndSequence >= boundary {
			return false
		}
	}
	if selected != 1 || !replacement && waits > 1 || replacement && (waits < 1 || waits > 3 || !(readiness == 0 && rearms == waits-1 || readiness > 0 && readiness <= rearms && rearms == waits && rearms <= 3 && lastWatcherAPI == "notify-readiness") || !(first.Error != "" && len(postSelected) == 0 || first.Error == "" && slices.Equal(postSelected, []string{"new-identity", "old-identity", "old-read", "new-read"}))) {
		return false
	}
	for _, call := range calls {
		if (call.API == "notify-wait" || call.API == "notify-rearm" || call.API == "notify-readiness") && call.EndSequence >= selectedBegin {
			return false
		}
	}
	for sequence := uint64(1); sequence <= uint64(2*len(calls)+1); sequence++ {
		if !seen[sequence] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return len(seen) == 2*len(calls)+1
}
func parentRefreshProof(records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, writeStarted time.Time, first cacheGatePositiveValue, connection uint64, expected storage.Attr, notify *parentNotifyResult) (bool, string) {
	var trigger *parentRefreshTrigger
	if notify != nil {
		trigger = &parentRefreshTrigger{notify.Request.Key.Connection, notify.At}
	}
	return parentRefreshAfterTrigger(records, writeStarted, first, connection, expected, trigger)
}

type parentRefreshTrigger struct {
	Connection uint64
	At         time.Time
}

func parentRefreshAfterTrigger(records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, writeStarted time.Time, first cacheGatePositiveValue, connection uint64, expected storage.Attr, notify *parentRefreshTrigger) (bool, string) {
	for _, request := range records {
		if request.Response || request.Bootstrap || request.Connection != connection || request.At.Before(writeStarted) || request.At.After(first.Completed) || request.Name != `v\target` {
			continue
		}
		if request.Command != wire.Create && !(request.Command == wire.QueryInfo && request.QueryType == 1 && (request.QueryClass == 18 || request.QueryClass == 34)) {
			continue
		}
		for _, response := range records {
			if !response.Response || response.Connection != request.Connection || response.SessionID != request.SessionID || response.MessageID != request.MessageID || response.Command != request.Command || response.Status != 0 || response.At.Before(request.At) || response.At.After(first.Completed.Add(200*time.Millisecond)) || response.EOF != uint64(expected.Size) || response.MTime != cacheGatePositiveTime(expected.ModTime) {
				continue
			}
			if notify != nil && (notify.Connection != connection || notify.At.Before(writeStarted) || notify.At.After(response.At)) {
				continue
			}
			if !response.At.After(first.Started) {
				return true, "refreshed_before_first_api"
			}
			if !request.At.Before(first.Started) {
				return true, "refreshed_by_first_api"
			}
		}
	}
	return false, "ambiguous_refresh_provenance"
}
func parentJoinSelectedTrace(first cacheGatePositiveValue, pending *parentNotifyRequest) ([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, bool) {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(200 * time.Millisecond)
	for {
		records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		if incomplete {
			return records, true
		}
		notifyJoined := pending == nil
		if pending != nil {
			_, results, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
			if bad {
				return records, true
			}
			for _, result := range results {
				if result.Request.Key == pending.Key {
					notifyJoined = true
				}
			}
		}
		for _, request := range records {
			if request.Response || request.At.Before(first.Started) || request.At.After(first.Completed) || request.Name != `v\target` || (request.Command != wire.Create && request.Command != wire.QueryInfo) {
				continue
			}
			for _, response := range records {
				if response.Response && response.Connection == request.Connection && response.MessageID == request.MessageID && response.Command == request.Command && response.Status != 0x103 && notifyJoined {
					return records, false
				}
			}
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return records, false
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

type parentInvalidationReport struct {
	NotificationMode                           string
	PreciseNotificationProven                  bool
	RescanRequired                             bool
	NotifyOutcomes                             []parentNotifyOutcome
	RescanReady                                *parentNotifyReadiness
	ReadinessAtFirst                           string
	ColdSourceChecked                          bool
	FirstObservationSequence                   uint64
	NotifyObservations                         []parentNotifyObservation
	Kind                                       string
	PreparedB                                  storage.Attr
	ColdSource                                 bool
	NotifyBatches                              []parentNotifyBatch
	OldIdentity, NewIdentity, RetainedIdentity cacheGatePositiveValue
	OldInitialRead, RetainedRead, NewRead      cacheGatePositiveValue
	IdentityResult                             string
	Name                                       string
	ShareMode                                  uint32
	Order                                      string
	UNC                                        string
	Qualification                              parentInvalidationQualification
	Classification                             string
	WithinOneSecondProven                      bool
	EvidenceValid                              bool
	Initial, Expected                          storage.Attr
	Warm                                       []cacheGatePositiveValue
	Pending                                    *parentNotifyRequest
	NativeNotify                               []parentNotifyItem
	WireNotify                                 []parentNotifyResult
	Wire                                       []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
	Events                                     []cacheGateEvent
	Error                                      string
	MutationBoundarySequence                   uint64
	NativeCalls                                []parentNativeCall
	Mechanism                                  string
	CandidateFailed                            bool
	OracleVerified                             bool
	OwnersClean                                bool
	TestFailed                                 bool
}

func parentExposure(records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) time.Time {
	var first time.Time
	for _, r := range records {
		if r.Response || r.Command != wire.Create || (r.Name != "" && r.Name != "v" && r.Name != `v\target`) {
			continue
		}
		if first.IsZero() || r.At.Before(first) {
			first = r.At
		}
	}
	return first
}
func parentCheckPolicy(t *testing.T, bridge *nativeBridge) {
	t.Helper()
	if bridge.wire.unsafeCaching.Load() || bridge.wire.leaseResponses.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("parent probe received caching rights")
	}
	bridge.wire.mu.Lock()
	defer bridge.wire.mu.Unlock()
	formal := false
	for _, n := range bridge.wire.negotiations {
		if (n.Dialect != 0x311 && n.Dialect != 0x2ff) || n.Capabilities != 4 {
			t.Fatalf("unsupported negotiation in parent probe: %+v", n)
		}
		formal = formal || n.Dialect == 0x311
	}
	if !formal {
		t.Fatal("parent probe lacks SMB3.1.1 negotiation")
	}
}
func parentAppShareProof(t *testing.T, bridge *nativeBridge, share uint32) {
	t.Helper()
	bridge.wire.mu.Lock()
	defer bridge.wire.mu.Unlock()
	for _, c := range bridge.wire.creates {
		if c.Name == "v" && c.ShareAccess == share && c.Access&win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY != 0 && !c.Truncated {
			return
		}
	}
	t.Fatal("application LIST/share mode was not observed on the child directory")
}
func parentRunCell(t *testing.T, name, order string, share uint32, watched bool, report *parentInvalidationReport) *parentInvalidationReport {
	t.Helper()
	kind := report.Kind
	if kind != "growth" && kind != "shrink" && kind != "replacement" {
		t.Fatal("unknown parent experiment kind")
	}
	trace := &cacheGateTrace{}
	cacheGateActive.Store(trace)
	cacheGateResetPositiveWire()
	parentNotifyReset()
	var bridge *nativeBridge
	var sequence uint64
	nextEvent := func() uint64 { sequence++; return sequence }
	beginCall := func(api, path string) int {
		report.NativeCalls = append(report.NativeCalls, parentNativeCall{API: api, Path: path, Started: time.Now(), BeginSequence: nextEvent()})
		return len(report.NativeCalls) - 1
	}
	endCall := func(index int, selected *cacheGatePositiveValue) {
		call := &report.NativeCalls[index]
		call.EndSequence = nextEvent()
		call.Completed = time.Now()
		if selected != nil {
			value := *selected
			call.Selected = &value
		}
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cacheGateActive.Store(nil)
		records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		_, results, notifyIncomplete := parentNotifySnapshot()
		report.Wire, report.WireNotify = records, results
		report.NotifyObservations = parentObservationSnapshot()
		if report.RescanRequired && (!parentRescanReadinessValid(report, report.NotifyObservations) || !parentRescanOutcomesValid(report, report.Qualification)) {
			report.WithinOneSecondProven = false
			report.Classification = "inconclusive"
			t.Error("final notification observation order does not prove a live rearm at the first API")
		}
		if !parentRecheckColdSource(report, records) {
			t.Error("final replacement source coldness is not proven; inspect ColdSourceChecked and the drained wire records")
		}
		trace.mu.Lock()
		report.Events = append([]cacheGateEvent(nil), trace.events...)
		traceBad := trace.overflow || trace.encodingError != nil
		trace.mu.Unlock()
		report.OwnersClean = false
		if bridge != nil {
			status := bridge.smb.Status()
			sessions, refs := bridge.backend.activeState()
			report.OwnersClean = sessions == 0 && refs == 0 && bridge.backend.openReferences() == 0 && status.Connections == 0 && status.RetainedConnections == 0 && status.PendingRequests == 0 && status.UnconfirmedMutations == 0 && status.CleanupFailures == 0 && status.LeaseSlots == 0 && status.LeaseBytes == 0
		}
		report.EvidenceValid = !incomplete && !notifyIncomplete && !traceBad && report.OwnersClean && report.OracleVerified && report.Classification != "inconclusive" && !t.Failed()
		if !report.EvidenceValid {
			report.Classification = "inconclusive"
			report.WithinOneSecondProven = false
		}
		if incomplete || notifyIncomplete || traceBad || !report.OwnersClean {
			t.Error("parent probe evidence or resource cleanup incomplete")
		}
		if report.EvidenceValid && report.CandidateFailed {
			t.Error("ancestor notification did not make the first qualified query current; candidate failure is not a post-deadline SLO witness")
		}
		report.TestFailed = t.Failed()
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
		if err == nil {
			err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "parent-"+name+".json"), data, 0600)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	sid, err := CurrentUserSID()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	policy, err := AllowSID(sid)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bridge = nativeBridgeFixture(t, policy)
	session, parent := nativeRemoteOpen(t, bridge.remote, "v", storage.NodeDirectory, true)
	file := nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "target", storage.NodeRegular)
	before, after := cacheGatePositivePayload(257, 0x17), cacheGatePositivePayload(769, 0x89)
	if kind == "shrink" {
		before = cacheGatePositivePayload(769, 0x17)
		after = before[:73]
	}
	report.Initial = cacheGatePositiveInitial(t, session, file, before, 2001)
	var replacement storage.File
	var metadataParent storage.File
	if kind == "replacement" {
		replacement = nativeRemoteCreateAt(t, session, parent, "replacement", storage.NodeRegular)
		report.PreparedB = cacheGatePositiveInitial(t, session, replacement, after, 2002)
		if report.PreparedB.ID == report.Initial.ID {
			t.Fatal("replacement fixture reused authority identity")
		}
		observed, err := parent.Stat(t.Context(), storage.ObservationOptions{})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		retained, err := session.Retain(t.Context(), storage.RetainRequest{NodeID: observed.Attr.ID}, nativeAction(t, session))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal("retain zero-use rename parent:", err)
		}
		metadataParent, err = session.Reference(t.Context(), retained.Reference)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if _, err := parent.Close(t.Context(), nativeAction(t, session)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("release setup-only parent claim:", err)
	}

	mappingCall := beginCall("map", `\\127.0.0.1\`+bridge.share)
	if err := bridge.mapDrive(t); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	endCall(mappingCall, nil)
	report.UNC = `\\127.0.0.1\` + bridge.share
	path := report.UNC + `\v\target`
	var application *nativeHandle
	var watch *parentNativeWatch
	openApplication := func() {
		var err error
		call := beginCall("open-application", report.UNC+`\v`)
		application, err = cacheGateSharingOpen(t, report.UNC+`\v`, win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY, share, true)
		endCall(call, nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("application child LIST/share%d open: %v", share, err)
		}
	}
	openWatcher := func() {
		call := beginCall("open-watcher", report.UNC)
		parentHandle, err := cacheGateSharingOpen(t, report.UNC+`\`, win.FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY, 7, true)
		endCall(call, nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal("parent LIST watcher open:", err)
		}
		call = beginCall("arm-watcher", report.UNC)
		watch = parentWatchStart(t, parentHandle)
		endCall(call, nil)
		pending := parentAwaitPending(t)
		report.Pending = &pending
	}
	if watched && order == "watcher_first" {
		openWatcher()
		openApplication()
	} else {
		openApplication()
		if watched {
			openWatcher()
		}
	}
	if application == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing application handle")
	}
	var oldHandle *nativeHandle
	if kind == "replacement" {
		call := beginCall("open-old-target", path)
		var opened cacheGatePositiveValue
		oldHandle, opened = cacheGatePositiveOpenSync(t, path)
		endCall(call, nil)
		if oldHandle == nil {
			t.Fatalf("prepare native retained A: %+v", opened)
		}
		call = beginCall("initial-old-identity", path)
		report.OldIdentity = cacheGatePositiveIdentity(oldHandle)
		endCall(call, nil)
		call = beginCall("initial-old-read", path)
		report.OldInitialRead = cacheGatePositiveReadSync(oldHandle)
		endCall(call, nil)
		if report.OldIdentity.Error != "" || report.OldIdentity.Identity == 0 || report.OldInitialRead.Error != "" || report.OldInitialRead.Count != uint32(len(before)) || report.OldInitialRead.Digest != cacheGatePositiveDigest(before) {
			t.Fatal("retained A identity or initial bytes unavailable")
		}
		call = beginCall("prepare-old-read", path)
		cacheGatePositiveSeek(t, oldHandle, 0)
		endCall(call, nil)
	}
	for range 2 {
		call := beginCall("warm-attributes", path)
		value := cacheGatePositivePath(path)
		endCall(call, nil)
		report.Warm = append(report.Warm, value)
		if value.Error != "" || value.Size != int64(len(before)) || value.MTime != cacheGatePositiveTime(report.Initial.ModTime) {
			t.Fatalf("positive target warm failed: %+v", value)
		}
	}
	parentCheckPolicy(t, bridge)
	parentAppShareProof(t, bridge, share)
	records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	connection, _, same := parentConnectionProof(records, report.Pending)
	exposure := parentExposure(records)
	if incomplete || !same || exposure.IsZero() {
		t.Fatal("target and parent do not have complete same-connection exposure evidence")
	}
	if watched {
		pending := parentAwaitPending(t)
		if pending.Key != report.Pending.Key {
			t.Fatal("watch changed between preparation and mutation")
		}
	} else {
		for _, r := range records {
			if r.Command == wire.ChangeNotify {
				t.Fatal("no-watcher control issued CHANGE_NOTIFY")
			}
		}
	}
	var rename storage.RenameRequest
	if kind == "replacement" {
		rename = storage.RenameRequest{Source: nativeTestTarget(t, metadataParent, "replacement"), Destination: nativeTestTarget(t, metadataParent, "target")}
	}
	action := nativeAction(t, session)
	q := parentInvalidationQualification{Watched: watched, Pending: watched, SameConnection: same, FirstExposure: exposure, EarliestExpiry: exposure.Add(cacheGatePositiveTTL(t)), Initial: report.Initial}
	if kind == "replacement" {
		prepared, bad := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		report.ColdSourceChecked = true
		report.ColdSource = !bad && parentColdSource(prepared, time.Now())
		if !report.ColdSource {
			t.Fatal("replacement B coldness is unproven before mutation")
		}
	}
	q.WriteStarted = time.Now()
	report.MutationBoundarySequence = nextEvent()
	var receipt storage.FileActionReceipt
	switch kind {
	case "growth":
		receipt, err = file.WriteAt(t.Context(), storage.FileWriteRequest{Data: after}, action)
	case "shrink":
		receipt, err = file.Truncate(t.Context(), storage.FileTruncateRequest{Size: 73}, action)
	case "replacement":
		receipt, err = replacement.Rename(t.Context(), rename, action)
	}
	q.ACK = time.Now()
	report.Expected = receipt.Observation.Attr
	q.Expected = report.Expected
	cacheGateObserve("parent_http_write_ack", map[string]any{"ack": q.ACK, "action": action, "receipt": receipt, "error": fmt.Sprint(err)})
	effect := storage.EffectContentChanged
	if kind == "replacement" {
		effect = storage.EffectEntryMoved
	}
	if err != nil || receipt.State != storage.FileActionCompleted || receipt.Effects&effect == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("remote mutation outcome unknown: %+v, %v", receipt, err)
	}
	if kind == "replacement" {
		if err := parentCollectRename(t, watch, report, &q, beginCall, endCall); err != nil {
			report.Error = err.Error()
			report.Qualification = q
			t.Error("replacement notification inconclusive:", err)
			return report
		}
	} else if watched {
		call := beginCall("notify-wait", report.UNC)
		items, notifyErr := watch.complete(q.ACK.Add(850 * time.Millisecond))
		q.NotifyCompleted = time.Now()
		endCall(call, nil)
		report.NativeNotify = items
		if notifyErr != nil {
			report.Error = notifyErr.Error()
			report.Qualification = q
			t.Error("native parent notification inconclusive:", notifyErr)
			return report
		}
		q.NativeModified = parentHasModified(items)
	}
	if kind == "replacement" {
		firstCall := beginCall("first-open", path)
		report.FirstObservationSequence = parentObservationBoundary()
		newHandle, opened := cacheGatePositiveOpenSync(t, path)
		q.Native = opened
		endCall(firstCall, &q.Native)
		if newHandle == nil {
			report.IdentityResult = "replacement_first_open_failed"
		} else {
			call := beginCall("new-identity", path)
			report.NewIdentity = cacheGatePositiveIdentity(newHandle)
			endCall(call, nil)
			call = beginCall("old-identity", path)
			report.RetainedIdentity = cacheGatePositiveIdentity(oldHandle)
			endCall(call, nil)
			call = beginCall("old-read", path)
			report.RetainedRead = cacheGatePositiveReadSync(oldHandle)
			endCall(call, nil)
			call = beginCall("new-read", path)
			report.NewRead = cacheGatePositiveReadSync(newHandle)
			endCall(call, nil)
			report.IdentityResult = parentRelativeIdentity(report.OldIdentity, report.NewIdentity, report.RetainedIdentity, report.RetainedRead, report.NewRead, before, after)
		}
	} else {
		firstCall := beginCall("first-attributes", path)
		q.Native = cacheGatePositivePath(path)
		endCall(firstCall, &q.Native)
	}
	joinPending := report.Pending
	if report.RescanRequired {
		joinPending = nil
	}
	records, incomplete = parentJoinSelectedTrace(q.Native, joinPending)
	_, results, notifyIncomplete := parentNotifySnapshot()
	q.TraceComplete = !incomplete && !notifyIncomplete
	q.Quiet = parentHarnessQuiet(report.NativeCalls, report.MutationBoundarySequence, q.Native)
	if kind == "replacement" {
		q.Quiet = parentHarnessOrdered(report.NativeCalls, report.MutationBoundarySequence, q.Native, true)
		report.ColdSource = report.ColdSource && parentColdSource(records, q.ACK)
	}
	var matchingNotify *parentNotifyResult
	for _, result := range results {
		if report.Pending != nil && result.Request.Key == report.Pending.Key && result.Request.Filter == parentNotifyFilter && result.Request.Recursive && !result.At.Before(q.WriteStarted) && !result.At.After(q.Native.Completed.Add(200*time.Millisecond)) && parentHasModified(result.Items) {
			q.WireModified = true
			matched := result
			matchingNotify = &matched
		}
	}
	if kind == "replacement" && len(report.NotifyBatches) > 0 {
		last := report.NotifyBatches[len(report.NotifyBatches)-1].Wire
		matchingNotify = &last
	}
	q.FreshTargetTraffic, report.Mechanism = parentRefreshProof(records, q.WriteStarted, q.Native, connection, report.Expected, matchingNotify)
	if report.RescanRequired {
		var trigger *parentRefreshTrigger
		for _, outcome := range report.NotifyOutcomes {
			if outcome.Mode == parentVerifiedRescan {
				trigger = &parentRefreshTrigger{outcome.Terminal.Connection, outcome.Terminal.At}
				break
			}
		}
		q.FreshTargetTraffic, report.Mechanism = parentRefreshAfterTrigger(records, q.WriteStarted, q.Native, connection, report.Expected, trigger)
		report.NotifyObservations = parentObservationSnapshot()
		if parentRescanReadinessValid(report, report.NotifyObservations) {
			report.ReadinessAtFirst = "observed_live_before_first_api"
		} else {
			q.TraceComplete = false
			report.ReadinessAtFirst = "inconclusive"
		}
	}
	for _, r := range records {
		if !watched && r.Command == wire.ChangeNotify {
			q.TraceComplete = false
		}
		if r.Command == wire.ChangeNotify && r.Response && r.Status != 0 && r.Status != 0x103 && !parentKnownRescan(report.NotifyOutcomes, r) && !parentLaterWatchCompletion(report, r) {
			q.TraceComplete = false
		}
		if r.Response && r.Command == wire.Create && (r.Oplock != 0 || r.LeasePresent || r.LeaseState != 0) {
			q.TraceComplete = false
		}
	}
	report.Qualification = q
	report.Wire = records
	switch kind {
	case "growth":
		report.Classification, report.WithinOneSecondProven = parentInvalidationClassify(q)
	case "shrink":
		report.Classification, report.WithinOneSecondProven = parentSizeClassify(q, 769, 73)
	case "replacement":
		report.Classification, report.WithinOneSecondProven = parentReplacementClassify(q, report)
	}
	cacheGateObserve("parent_first_result", report)
	// The independent oracle runs only after the single measured native query.
	if kind == "replacement" {
		cacheGatePositiveOracle(t, file, report.Initial, before)
		cacheGatePositiveOracle(t, replacement, report.Expected, after)
		if _, err := bridge.remote.Stat(t.Context(), "v/replacement"); !errors.Is(err, syscall.ENOENT) {
			t.Fatalf("replacement source name was not removed: %v", err)
		}
	} else {
		cacheGatePositiveOracle(t, file, report.Expected, after)
	}
	report.OracleVerified = true
	runtime.KeepAlive(application)
	runtime.KeepAlive(watch)
	if report.Classification == "inconclusive" {
		t.Error("parent probe qualification failed; result is inconclusive")
	} else if watched && !report.WithinOneSecondProven {
		report.CandidateFailed = true
	}
	return report
}
func TestNativeParentInvalidation(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_VARIANT") != "positive_parent_invalidation" {
		t.Fatal("parent invalidation variant required")
	}
	reports := map[string]*parentInvalidationReport{}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		result := map[string]any{"evidence_kind": "pinned prototype ancestor notification diagnostic; not production mount or complete acceptance", "prototype": "1cb9ad7f49d998de4daa4d562d766b18cf06ce16", "cells": reports, "test_failed": t.Failed(), "cache_policy": "unchanged; verified by external harness", "geometry": "real share root / real child v / target; models synthetic parent only"}
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
		if err == nil {
			err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "receipt.json"), data, 0600)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	for _, cell := range []struct {
		name, order, kind string
		share             uint32
		watched           bool
	}{
		{"noWatcher", "app_first", "growth", 0, false},
		{"share0_watcher_first", "watcher_first", "growth", 0, true},
		{"share0_app_first", "app_first", "growth", 0, true},
		{"share6_watcher_first", "watcher_first", "growth", 6, true},
		{"share6_app_first", "app_first", "growth", 6, true},
		{"share0_app_first_shrink", "app_first", "shrink", 0, true},
		{"share0_app_first_replace_identity", "app_first", "replacement", 0, true},
	} {
		reports[cell.name] = &parentInvalidationReport{Kind: cell.kind, Name: cell.name, ShareMode: cell.share, Order: cell.order, Classification: "inconclusive"}
		t.Run(cell.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			parentRunCell(t, cell.name, cell.order, cell.share, cell.watched, reports[cell.name])
		})
	}
}

func parentTestNotifyBuffer(items ...parentNotifyItem) []byte {
	var out []byte
	for i, item := range items {
		words := utf16.Encode([]rune(item.Name))
		size := 12 + 2*len(words)
		if i+1 < len(items) {
			size = (size + 3) &^ 3
		}
		block := make([]byte, size)
		if i+1 < len(items) {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(block, uint32(size))
		}
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(block[4:], item.Action)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(block[8:], uint32(len(words)*2))
		for j, w := range words {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(block[12+2*j:], w)
		}
		out = append(out, block...)
	}
	return out
}
func TestParentInvalidationNotifyParsing(t *testing.T) {
	valid := parentTestNotifyBuffer(parentNotifyItem{3, `v\target`}, parentNotifyItem{3, `v\other`})
	items, err := parentNotifyDecode(valid)
	if err != nil || len(items) != 2 || !parentHasModified(items) {
		t.Fatalf("valid MODIFY buffer: %+v, %v", items, err)
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func([]byte) []byte
	}{
		{"empty", func([]byte) []byte { return nil }},
		{"truncated", func(b []byte) []byte { return b[:11] }},
		{"odd UTF16", func(b []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b[8:], 3); return b }},
		{"overlap", func(b []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b, 12); return b }},
		{"out of bounds next", func(b []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b, 0xfffffff0); return b }},
		{"invalid action", func(b []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b[4:], 0); return b }},
		{"unpaired surrogate", func(b []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(b[12:], 0xdc00); return b }},
		{"huge", func([]byte) []byte { return make([]byte, parentNotifyLimit+1) }},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := parentNotifyDecode(test.mutate(append([]byte(nil), valid...))); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("malformed notification accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	for _, items := range [][]parentNotifyItem{{{1, `v\target`}}, {{3, "target"}}, {{3, `v\target2`}}, {{3, `other\target`}}} {
		if parentHasModified(items) {
			t.Fatalf("wrong action or exact path accepted: %+v", items)
		}
	}
}
func TestParentInvalidationHookCorrelation(t *testing.T) {
	parentNotifyReset()
	t.Cleanup(parentNotifyReset)
	request := make([]byte, wire.HeaderSize+32)
	body := request[wire.HeaderSize:]
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 32)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[2:], 1)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[4:], 4096)
	body[8] = 17
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[24:], parentNotifyFilter)
	r := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1, MessageID: 7, SessionID: 13}
	if !cacheGateParentNotifyRequest(request, &r) {
		t.Fatal("valid notify request rejected")
	}
	payload := parentTestNotifyBuffer(parentNotifyItem{3, `v\target`})
	response := make([]byte, wire.HeaderSize+8+len(payload))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(response[wire.HeaderSize:], 9)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(response[wire.HeaderSize+2:], uint16(wire.HeaderSize+8))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(response[wire.HeaderSize+4:], uint32(len(payload)))
	copy(response[wire.HeaderSize+8:], payload)
	if !cacheGateParentNotifyResponse(response, &r) {
		t.Fatal("matching response rejected")
	}
	_, results, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
	if bad || len(results) != 1 || results[0].Request.Filter != parentNotifyFilter || !results[0].Request.Recursive || !parentHasModified(results[0].Items) {
		t.Fatalf("decoded correlation lost: %+v bad=%v", results, bad)
	}
	other := r
	other.Connection = 2
	if cacheGateParentNotifyResponse(response, &other) {
		t.Fatal("different connection satisfied pending request")
	}
	parentNotifyReset()
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[24:], 3)
	if !cacheGateParentNotifyRequest(request, &r) {
		t.Fatal("valid different filter must remain observable")
	}
	requests, _, _ := parentNotifySnapshot()
	if len(requests) != 1 || requests[0].Filter == parentNotifyFilter {
		t.Fatal("filter mismatch was hidden")
	}
}
func TestParentInvalidationQualification(t *testing.T) {
	parentTestTypedNotify(t)
	parentTestExpandedCases(t)
	parentTestReplacementQualification(t)
	t.Run("target shares observed parent connection", func(t *testing.T) {
		records := []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{
			{Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, SessionID: 9, Name: "", FileID: "root"},
			{Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, SessionID: 9, Name: "v", FileID: "child"},
			{Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, SessionID: 9, Name: `v\target`, FileID: "target"},
		}
		request := &parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{1, 7}, Session: 9, FileID: "root"}
		if connection, session, ok := parentConnectionProof(records, request); !ok || connection != 1 || session != 9 {
			t.Fatal("complete target binding rejected", connection, session, ok)
		}
		if _, _, ok := parentConnectionProof(records[:2], request); ok {
			t.Fatal("parent-only trace proved target binding")
		}
		if _, _, ok := parentConnectionProof(records[:2], nil); ok {
			t.Fatal("no-watcher parent-only trace proved target binding")
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			change func(*cacheGatePositiveWireRecord)
		}{
			{"different target connection", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.Connection = 2 }},
			{"different target session", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.SessionID = 10 }},
			{"target open failed", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.Status = 0xc0000001 }},
			{"target identity absent", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.FileID = "" }},
			{"target reused watcher identity", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.FileID = "root" }},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				changed := append([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord(nil), records...)
				test.change(&changed[2])
				if _, _, ok := parentConnectionProof(changed, request); ok {
					t.Fatal("unproven target connection accepted")
				}
			})
		}
	})
	t.Run("ordered harness ledger tolerates tied clocks", func(t *testing.T) {
		at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
		first := cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at, Completed: at, Size: 769, MTime: 17}
		calls := []parentNativeCall{
			{API: "warm-attributes", Started: at, Completed: at, BeginSequence: 1, EndSequence: 2},
			{API: "notify-wait", Started: at, Completed: at, BeginSequence: 4, EndSequence: 5},
			{API: "first-attributes", Started: at, Completed: at, BeginSequence: 6, EndSequence: 7, Selected: &first},
		}
		if !parentHarnessQuiet(calls, 3, first) {
			t.Fatal("ordered prep with tied timestamps rejected")
		}
		for _, api := range []string{"open-application", "warm-attributes", "enumerate", "get-info", "read"} {
			contaminated := append([]parentNativeCall(nil), calls[:2]...)
			contaminated = append(contaminated, parentNativeCall{API: api, Started: at, Completed: at, BeginSequence: 6, EndSequence: 7})
			selected := calls[2]
			selected.BeginSequence, selected.EndSequence = 8, 9
			contaminated = append(contaminated, selected)
			if parentHarnessQuiet(contaminated, 3, first) {
				t.Fatalf("tied-clock intervening %s accepted", api)
			}
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			change func([]parentNativeCall, *uint64)
		}{
			{"zero boundary", func(_ []parentNativeCall, b *uint64) { *b = 0 }},
			{"missing begin", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) { c[0].BeginSequence = 0 }},
			{"missing end", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) { c[0].EndSequence = 0 }},
			{"duplicate sequence", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) { c[1].EndSequence = c[0].EndSequence }},
			{"reversed sequence", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) { c[0].BeginSequence, c[0].EndSequence = 2, 1 }},
			{"missing event", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) { c[2].EndSequence = 8 }},
			{"boundary spans forbidden call", func(c []parentNativeCall, b *uint64) { *b = 2; c[0].EndSequence = 3 }},
			{"postboundary forbidden call", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) { c[1].API = "get-info" }},
			{"selected before boundary", func(c []parentNativeCall, b *uint64) { *b = 7; c[2].BeginSequence, c[2].EndSequence = 3, 6 }},
			{"selected observation missing", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) { c[2].Selected = nil }},
			{"selected value mismatch", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) { v := *c[2].Selected; v.Size++; c[2].Selected = &v }},
			{"selected time mismatch", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) {
				v := *c[2].Selected
				v.Started = v.Started.Add(time.Nanosecond)
				c[2].Selected = &v
			}},
			{"selected duplicated", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) { c[1].API = "first-attributes"; c[1].Selected = &first }},
			{"record order reversed", func(c []parentNativeCall, _ *uint64) { c[0], c[1] = c[1], c[0] }},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				changed := append([]parentNativeCall(nil), calls...)
				boundary := uint64(3)
				test.change(changed, &boundary)
				if parentHarnessQuiet(changed, boundary, first) {
					t.Fatal("invalid ordered ledger accepted")
				}
			})
		}
		observed := first
		observed.Started = time.Now()
		observed.Completed = observed.Started
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(observed)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var decoded cacheGatePositiveValue
		if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &decoded); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		roundtrip := append([]parentNativeCall(nil), calls...)
		roundtrip[2].Started, roundtrip[2].Completed, roundtrip[2].Selected = observed.Started, observed.Completed, &decoded
		if !parentHarnessQuiet(roundtrip, 3, observed) {
			t.Fatal("JSON observation lost semantic time identity")
		}
	})
	t.Run("automatic redirector refresh remains eligible", func(t *testing.T) {
		at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
		first := cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at.Add(100 * time.Millisecond), Completed: at.Add(200 * time.Millisecond)}
		expected := storage.Attr{Size: 769, ModTime: at}
		request := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at.Add(10 * time.Millisecond), Connection: 2, SessionID: 9, MessageID: 7, Command: wire.Create, Name: `v\target`}
		response := request
		response.Response = true
		response.At = at.Add(30 * time.Millisecond)
		response.EOF = 769
		response.MTime = cacheGatePositiveTime(at)
		notify := parentNotifyResult{Request: parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{2, 5}}, At: at.Add(5 * time.Millisecond)}
		if fresh, mechanism := parentRefreshProof([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{request, response}, at, first, 2, expected, &notify); !fresh || mechanism != "refreshed_before_first_api" {
			t.Fatal("automatic notify refresh was excluded", fresh, mechanism)
		}
		notify.At = at.Add(40 * time.Millisecond)
		if fresh, _ := parentRefreshProof([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{request, response}, at, first, 2, expected, &notify); fresh {
			t.Fatal("ambiguous notification ordering accepted")
		}
	})
	t.Run("successful response evidence", func(t *testing.T) {
		at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
		first := cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at.Add(100 * time.Millisecond), Completed: at.Add(200 * time.Millisecond)}
		expected := storage.Attr{Size: 769, ModTime: at}
		request := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at.Add(150 * time.Millisecond), Connection: 2, SessionID: 9, MessageID: 7, Command: wire.Create, Name: `v\target`}
		response := request
		response.Response = true
		response.At = first.Completed.Add(time.Millisecond)
		response.EOF = 769
		response.MTime = cacheGatePositiveTime(at)
		if fresh, _ := parentRefreshProof([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{request, response}, at, first, 2, expected, nil); !fresh {
			t.Fatal("matched current response rejected")
		}
		if fresh, _ := parentRefreshProof([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{request}, at, first, 2, expected, nil); fresh {
			t.Fatal("request dispatch became refresh proof")
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			change func(*cacheGatePositiveWireRecord)
		}{
			{"failed", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.Status = 0xc0000001 }},
			{"wrong size", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.EOF = 257 }},
			{"wrong mtime", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.MTime-- }},
			{"wrong connection", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.Connection++ }},
			{"wrong session", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.SessionID++ }},
			{"wrong request", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.MessageID++ }},
			{"unbounded join", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) { r.At = first.Completed.Add(201 * time.Millisecond) }},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				r := response
				test.change(&r)
				if fresh, _ := parentRefreshProof([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{request, r}, at, first, 2, expected, nil); fresh {
					t.Fatal("uncorrelated or noncurrent response accepted")
				}
			})
		}
	})
	at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
	old := storage.Attr{ID: 3, Size: 257, MetadataRevision: 2, ModTime: at.Add(-24 * time.Hour)}
	current := storage.Attr{ID: 3, Size: 769, MetadataRevision: 4, ModTime: at}
	valid := parentInvalidationQualification{Watched: true, Pending: true, NativeModified: true, WireModified: true, SameConnection: true, Quiet: true, FreshTargetTraffic: true, TraceComplete: true, ACK: at, WriteStarted: at.Add(-time.Millisecond), NotifyCompleted: at.Add(50 * time.Millisecond), FirstExposure: at.Add(-time.Second), EarliestExpiry: at.Add(4 * time.Second), Initial: old, Expected: current, Native: cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at.Add(100 * time.Millisecond), Completed: at.Add(200 * time.Millisecond), Size: 769, MTime: cacheGatePositiveTime(current.ModTime)}}
	if classification, proved := parentInvalidationClassify(valid); classification != "current_before_deadline" || !proved {
		t.Fatal("qualified current result rejected", classification, proved)
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		change func(*parentInvalidationQualification)
	}{
		{"no pending", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Pending = false }},
		{"wrong native action or name", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.NativeModified = false }},
		{"notification completed after first query", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.NotifyCompleted = q.Native.Started.Add(time.Nanosecond) }},
		{"wrong wire filter or name", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.WireModified = false }},
		{"different connection", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.SameConnection = false }},
		{"intervening ancestor query", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Quiet = false }},
		{"trace overflow", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.TraceComplete = false }},
		{"no authoritative target request", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.FreshTargetTraffic = false }},
		{"late completion", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) {
			q.Native.Completed = q.ACK.Add(time.Second + time.Nanosecond)
		}},
		{"expired oldest exposure", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.EarliestExpiry = q.Native.Completed }},
		{"query before ack", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Native.Started = q.ACK.Add(-time.Nanosecond) }},
		{"unknown error", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Native.Error = "I/O unknown" }},
		{"identity replaced", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Expected.ID++ }},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			q := valid
			test.change(&q)
			if classification, proved := parentInvalidationClassify(q); classification != "inconclusive" || proved {
				t.Fatalf("invalid proof accepted: %s %v", classification, proved)
			}
		})
	}
	q := valid
	q.Watched = false
	q.Native.Size = old.Size
	q.Native.MTime = cacheGatePositiveTime(old.ModTime)
	if classification, proved := parentInvalidationClassify(q); classification != "control_old_first_sample_observation_only" || proved {
		t.Fatal("old first control became an SLO violation", classification, proved)
	}
	q.Native.Completed = q.ACK.Add(time.Second + time.Nanosecond)
	if classification, proved := parentInvalidationClassify(q); classification != "inconclusive" || proved {
		t.Fatal("late control became timely proof", classification, proved)
	}
}

type parentNotifyBatch struct {
	Pending   parentNotifyRequest
	Native    []parentNotifyItem
	Wire      parentNotifyResult
	Completed time.Time
}

func parentRenameBatchState(batches []parentNotifyBatch, original parentNotifyRequest) (bool, bool) {
	if len(batches) == 0 || len(batches) > 3 {
		return false, false
	}
	removed, renamed := false, false
	seen := map[parentNotifyKey]bool{}
	for _, batch := range batches {
		p := batch.Pending
		if p.Key.Connection != original.Key.Connection || p.Session != original.Session || p.FileID != original.FileID || p.Filter != parentNotifyFilter || !p.Recursive || seen[p.Key] || batch.Wire.Request != p || !slices.Equal(batch.Native, batch.Wire.Items) || len(batch.Native) == 0 {
			return false, false
		}
		seen[p.Key] = true
		for i := 0; i < len(batch.Native); i++ {
			item := batch.Native[i]
			if item.Action == 2 && item.Name == `v\target` && !removed && !renamed {
				removed = true
				continue
			}
			if item.Action == 4 && item.Name == `v\replacement` && removed && !renamed && i+1 < len(batch.Native) && batch.Native[i+1] == (parentNotifyItem{5, `v\target`}) {
				renamed = true
				i++
				continue
			}
			return false, false
		}
	}
	return removed && renamed, true
}
func parentRecheckColdSource(report *parentInvalidationReport, records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	if report.Kind != "replacement" {
		return true
	}
	report.ColdSource = report.ColdSourceChecked && report.ColdSource && parentColdSource(records, report.Qualification.ACK)
	if !report.ColdSource {
		report.EvidenceValid = false
		report.WithinOneSecondProven = false
		report.Classification = "inconclusive"
	}
	return report.ColdSource
}

func parentColdSource(records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, boundary time.Time) bool {
	type fileKey struct {
		Connection uint64
		ID         string
	}
	type createKey struct{ Connection, Message uint64 }
	known := map[fileKey]bool{}
	creates := map[createKey]string{}
	for _, r := range records {
		if r.Name == `v\replacement` && (r.Command == wire.Create || r.Command == wire.QueryInfo || r.Command == wire.Read) {
			return false
		}
		if r.At.After(boundary) {
			continue
		}
		if r.Command == wire.QueryDirectory {
			return false
		}
		if r.Name != "" && r.Name != "v" && r.Name != `v\target` {
			return false
		}
		if r.Command == wire.Create && r.Response && r.Status == 0 && r.FileID != "" {
			known[fileKey{r.Connection, r.FileID}] = true
			creates[createKey{r.Connection, r.MessageID}] = r.FileID
		}
	}
	for _, r := range records {
		if r.At.After(boundary) || r.Response || (r.Command != wire.Read && r.Command != wire.QueryInfo) {
			continue
		}
		id := r.FileID
		if r.RelatedCreate != 0 {
			id = creates[createKey{r.Connection, r.RelatedCreate}]
		}
		if id == "" || !known[fileKey{r.Connection, id}] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func parentRelativeIdentity(initial, current, retained, oldRead, newRead cacheGatePositiveValue, oldData, newData []byte) string {
	if initial.Error != "" || current.Error != "" || retained.Error != "" || initial.Identity == 0 || current.Identity == 0 || retained.Identity == 0 {
		return "identity_unavailable"
	}
	if current.Volume != initial.Volume || retained.Volume != initial.Volume {
		return "volume_identity_changed"
	}
	if initial.Size != int64(len(oldData)) || retained.Size != int64(len(oldData)) || current.Size != int64(len(newData)) {
		return "native_handle_size_wrong"
	}
	if retained.Identity != initial.Identity {
		return "retained_identity_changed"
	}
	if current.Identity == initial.Identity {
		return "replacement_identity_aliased"
	}
	if oldRead.Error != "" || oldRead.Count != uint32(len(oldData)) || oldRead.Digest != cacheGatePositiveDigest(oldData) {
		return "retained_bytes_changed"
	}
	if newRead.Error != "" || newRead.Count != uint32(len(newData)) || newRead.Digest != cacheGatePositiveDigest(newData) {
		return "replacement_bytes_wrong"
	}
	return "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes"
}
func parentWithinWindow(value cacheGatePositiveValue, ack, expiry time.Time) bool {
	return !value.Started.Before(ack) && !value.Completed.Before(value.Started) && !value.Completed.After(ack.Add(time.Second)) && value.Completed.Before(expiry)
}
func parentKnownRescan(outcomes []parentNotifyOutcome, record cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	for _, outcome := range outcomes {
		if outcome.Mode == parentVerifiedRescan && record == outcome.Terminal && record.Status == parentStatusNotifyEnum {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func parentLaterWatchCompletion(report *parentInvalidationReport, record cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	if !report.RescanRequired || report.RescanReady == nil || report.FirstObservationSequence == 0 {
		return false
	}
	request := report.RescanReady.Pending
	if !record.Response || record.Command != wire.ChangeNotify || record.Status == 0x103 || record.Connection != request.Key.Connection || record.MessageID != request.Key.MessageID || record.SessionID != request.Session || record.FileID != request.FileID {
		return false
	}
	for _, observation := range report.NotifyObservations {
		if observation.Record == record && observation.Sequence > report.FirstObservationSequence {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func parentRescanOutcomesValid(report *parentInvalidationReport, q parentInvalidationQualification) bool {
	if report.Pending == nil || report.RescanReady == nil || len(report.NotifyOutcomes) < 1 || len(report.NotifyOutcomes) > 3 {
		return false
	}
	original := *report.Pending
	seen := map[parentNotifyKey]bool{}
	rescans := 0
	for index, outcome := range report.NotifyOutcomes {
		request := outcome.Pending
		if seen[request.Key] || index == 0 && request != original || request.Key.Connection != original.Key.Connection || request.Session != original.Session || request.FileID != original.FileID || request.Filter != original.Filter || request.Recursive != original.Recursive || request.Capacity != original.Capacity {
			return false
		}
		seen[request.Key] = true
		var details []parentNotifyResult
		if outcome.Detail != nil {
			details = append(details, *outcome.Detail)
		}
		matched, ready, err := parentMatchNotifyOutcome(request, outcome.Native, report.Wire, details)
		if err != nil || !ready || matched.Mode != outcome.Mode || matched.Terminal != outcome.Terminal || outcome.Native.Completed.Before(q.WriteStarted) || outcome.Native.Completed.After(q.ACK.Add(850*time.Millisecond)) || outcome.Terminal.At.Before(q.WriteStarted) || outcome.Terminal.At.After(q.Native.Started) {
			return false
		}
		if outcome.Mode == parentVerifiedRescan {
			rescans++
		}
	}
	ready := report.RescanReady
	return rescans > 0 && !seen[ready.Pending.Key] && !ready.Checked.Before(q.WriteStarted) && !ready.Checked.After(q.ACK.Add(850*time.Millisecond)) && !ready.Checked.After(q.Native.Started)
}

func parentReplacementClassify(q parentInvalidationQualification, report *parentInvalidationReport) (string, bool) {
	if !q.TraceComplete || !q.SameConnection || !q.Quiet || report.Pending == nil || !report.ColdSourceChecked || !report.ColdSource || !q.Pending || !parentWithinWindow(q.Native, q.ACK, q.EarliestExpiry) || q.FirstExposure.IsZero() || q.Initial.Size != 257 || report.PreparedB.Size != 769 || q.Expected.ID == q.Initial.ID || q.Expected.ID != report.PreparedB.ID || q.Expected.Size != 769 || !q.Expected.ModTime.Equal(report.PreparedB.ModTime) || q.Expected.MetadataRevision < report.PreparedB.MetadataRevision || q.NotifyCompleted.IsZero() || q.NotifyCompleted.Before(q.WriteStarted) || q.NotifyCompleted.After(q.Native.Started) {
		return "inconclusive", false
	}
	if report.RescanRequired {
		if report.NotificationMode != parentVerifiedRescan || report.PreciseNotificationProven || !parentRescanOutcomesValid(report, q) || !parentRescanReadinessValid(report, report.NotifyObservations) {
			return "inconclusive", false
		}
	} else {
		if report.NotificationMode != parentDetail || !report.PreciseNotificationProven {
			return "inconclusive", false
		}
		complete, valid := parentRenameBatchState(report.NotifyBatches, *report.Pending)
		for _, batch := range report.NotifyBatches {
			if batch.Completed.Before(q.WriteStarted) || batch.Completed.After(q.ACK.Add(850*time.Millisecond)) || batch.Wire.At.Before(q.WriteStarted) || batch.Wire.At.After(q.Native.Started) {
				return "inconclusive", false
			}
		}
		if !valid || !complete {
			return "inconclusive", false
		}
	}
	if q.Native.Error != "" {
		return "replacement_first_open_failed", false
	}
	for _, value := range []cacheGatePositiveValue{report.NewIdentity, report.RetainedIdentity, report.RetainedRead, report.NewRead} {
		if !parentWithinWindow(value, q.ACK, q.EarliestExpiry) {
			return "replacement_native_check_deadline_failed", false
		}
	}
	if report.IdentityResult != "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes" {
		return report.IdentityResult, false
	}
	if !q.FreshTargetTraffic {
		return "inconclusive", false
	}
	if report.RescanRequired {
		return "current_replacement_identity_after_verified_rescan_before_deadline", true
	}
	return "current_replacement_identity_before_deadline", true
}

func (w *parentNativeWatch) rearm() error {
	if !w.done {
		return errors.New("rearm attempted before notification drain")
	}
	if err := win.ResetEvent(w.event); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	clear(w.buffer)
	w.overlap = win.Overlapped{HEvent: w.event}
	err := win.ReadDirectoryChanges(w.file.value, &w.buffer[0], uint32(len(w.buffer)), true, parentNotifyFilter, nil, &w.overlap, 0)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, win.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
		return err
	}
	w.done = false
	return nil
}
func parentNotificationResult(current parentNotifyRequest, deadline time.Time) (parentNotifyResult, error) {
	for {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return parentNotifyResult{}, errors.New("notification trace join exceeded absolute deadline")
		}
		_, results, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
		_, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		if bad || incomplete {
			return parentNotifyResult{}, errors.New("notification evidence incomplete")
		}
		for _, result := range results {
			if result.Request.Key == current.Key {
				return result, nil
			}
		}
		if !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
			return parentNotifyResult{}, errors.New("notification trace join exceeded absolute deadline")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}
func parentSelectRearmPending(original parentNotifyRequest, previous map[parentNotifyKey]bool, requests []parentNotifyRequest, records []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) (parentNotifyRequest, bool, error) {
	for _, request := range requests {
		if previous[request.Key] {
			continue
		}
		if request.Key.Connection != original.Key.Connection || request.Session != original.Session || request.FileID != original.FileID || request.Filter != original.Filter || request.Recursive != original.Recursive {
			return parentNotifyRequest{}, false, errors.New("rearm changed watcher identity or filter")
		}
		for _, r := range records {
			if r.Response && r.Command == wire.ChangeNotify && r.Connection == request.Key.Connection && r.SessionID == request.Session && r.MessageID == request.Key.MessageID && r.Status == 0x103 {
				return request, true, nil
			}
		}
	}
	return parentNotifyRequest{}, false, nil
}
func parentRearmedPending(original parentNotifyRequest, previous map[parentNotifyKey]bool, deadline time.Time) (parentNotifyRequest, error) {
	for {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return parentNotifyRequest{}, errors.New("rearm pending exceeded absolute deadline")
		}
		requests, _, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
		records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
		if bad || incomplete {
			return parentNotifyRequest{}, errors.New("rearmed notification evidence incomplete")
		}
		request, found, err := parentSelectRearmPending(original, previous, requests, records)
		if err != nil {
			return parentNotifyRequest{}, err
		}
		if found {
			return request, nil
		}
		if !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
			return parentNotifyRequest{}, errors.New("rearm did not establish a new actual pending request")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}
func parentCollectRename(t *testing.T, watch *parentNativeWatch, report *parentInvalidationReport, q *parentInvalidationQualification, begin func(string, string) int, end func(int, *cacheGatePositiveValue)) error {
	current, original := *report.Pending, *report.Pending
	deadline := q.ACK.Add(850 * time.Millisecond)
	report.NotificationMode = parentDetail
	for index := 0; index < 3; index++ {
		call := begin("notify-wait", report.UNC)
		native, nativeErr := watch.completeNative(deadline)
		q.NotifyCompleted = native.Completed
		end(call, nil)
		if nativeErr != nil && !(native.Drained && native.ErrorCode == parentErrorNotifyEnum) {
			return nativeErr
		}
		outcome, err := parentAwaitNotifyOutcome(current, native, deadline)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if outcome.Terminal.At.Before(q.WriteStarted) || native.Completed.After(deadline) {
			return errors.New("rename notification outside measured interval")
		}
		report.NotifyOutcomes = append(report.NotifyOutcomes, outcome)
		if outcome.Mode == parentVerifiedRescan {
			report.NotificationMode, report.RescanRequired = parentVerifiedRescan, true
			report.PreciseNotificationProven = false
		} else {
			report.NotifyBatches = append(report.NotifyBatches, parentNotifyBatch{Pending: current, Native: native.Items, Wire: *outcome.Detail, Completed: native.Completed})
			report.NativeNotify = append(report.NativeNotify, native.Items...)
		}
		if !report.RescanRequired {
			complete, valid := parentRenameBatchState(report.NotifyBatches, original)
			if !valid {
				return errors.New("rename notification names, order, or lineage ambiguous")
			}
			if complete {
				report.PreciseNotificationProven = true
				return nil
			}
			if index == 2 {
				return errors.New("rename notification batch bound exhausted")
			}
		}
		requests, _, bad := parentNotifySnapshot()
		if bad {
			return errors.New("notification request history incomplete")
		}
		previous := make(map[parentNotifyKey]bool, len(requests))
		for _, request := range requests {
			previous[request.Key] = true
		}
		call = begin("notify-rearm", report.UNC)
		err = watch.rearm()
		end(call, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		current, err = parentRearmedPending(original, previous, deadline)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if report.RescanRequired {
			call = begin("notify-readiness", report.UNC)
			state, eventErr := win.WaitForSingleObject(watch.event, 0)
			records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
			_, terminal, terminalErr := parentNotifyTerminal(current, records)
			ready := parentNotifyReadiness{Pending: current, Checked: time.Now(), NativePending: state == uint32(win.WAIT_TIMEOUT), TerminalObserved: terminal, ObservationSequence: parentObservationBoundary()}
			end(call, nil)
			ready.EndSequence = report.NativeCalls[call].EndSequence
			if eventErr != nil {
				return eventErr
			}
			if incomplete || terminalErr != nil {
				return errors.New("notification readiness trace is incomplete")
			}
			if ready.Checked.After(deadline) {
				return errors.New("notification readiness exceeded absolute deadline")
			}
			if ready.NativePending && !terminal {
				report.RescanReady = &ready
				return nil
			}
			if state != uint32(win.WAIT_OBJECT_0) && state != uint32(win.WAIT_TIMEOUT) {
				return errors.New("unexpected notification readiness event state")
			}
		}
	}
	return errors.New("notification completion bound exhausted before live rearm")
}

func parentRescanReadinessValid(report *parentInvalidationReport, observed []parentNotifyObservation) bool {
	ready := report.RescanReady
	if ready == nil || !ready.NativePending || ready.TerminalObserved || ready.ObservationSequence == 0 || ready.ObservationSequence >= report.FirstObservationSequence || ready.EndSequence == 0 || report.Pending == nil {
		return false
	}
	bound, firstBegin := false, uint64(0)
	for _, call := range report.NativeCalls {
		if call.API == "notify-readiness" && call.EndSequence == ready.EndSequence && !ready.Checked.Before(call.Started) && !ready.Checked.After(call.Completed) {
			bound = true
		}
		if call.API == "first-open" {
			firstBegin = call.BeginSequence
		}
	}
	if !bound || firstBegin <= ready.EndSequence {
		return false
	}
	original := *report.Pending
	if ready.Pending.Key == original.Key || ready.Pending.Key.Connection != original.Key.Connection || ready.Pending.Session != original.Session || ready.Pending.FileID != original.FileID || ready.Pending.Filter != original.Filter || ready.Pending.Recursive != original.Recursive || ready.Pending.Capacity != original.Capacity {
		return false
	}
	pending, terminals := 0, 0
	var previous uint64
	for _, observation := range observed {
		if observation.Sequence == 0 || observation.Sequence <= previous {
			return false
		}
		previous = observation.Sequence
		r := observation.Record
		if r.Connection != ready.Pending.Key.Connection || r.MessageID != ready.Pending.Key.MessageID {
			continue
		}
		if r.Command != wire.ChangeNotify || !r.Response || r.SessionID != ready.Pending.Session || r.FileID != ready.Pending.FileID || r.Incomplete != "" {
			return false
		}
		if r.Status == 0x103 {
			pending++
			if observation.Sequence >= ready.ObservationSequence {
				return false
			}
		} else {
			terminals++
			if observation.Sequence <= report.FirstObservationSequence {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return pending == 1 && terminals <= 1
}

func parentTestExpandedCases(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("final drained trace can invalidate but never upgrade coldness", func(t *testing.T) {
		at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
		early := []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{{At: at, Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, Name: `v\target`, FileID: "A"}}
		identity := "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes"
		report := parentInvalidationReport{Kind: "replacement", ColdSource: true, ColdSourceChecked: true, EvidenceValid: true, WithinOneSecondProven: true, Classification: "current_replacement_identity_before_deadline", IdentityResult: identity, Qualification: parentInvalidationQualification{ACK: at}}
		if !parentRecheckColdSource(&report, early) {
			t.Fatal("clean early source trace rejected")
		}
