		drained := append(slices.Clone(early), cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at.Add(time.Millisecond), Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, Name: `v\replacement`, FileID: "B"})
		if parentRecheckColdSource(&report, drained) || report.ColdSource || report.EvidenceValid || report.WithinOneSecondProven || report.Classification != "inconclusive" {
			t.Fatal("late B exposure retained a successful verdict")
		}
		if report.IdentityResult != identity {
			t.Fatal("coldness failure erased raw native identity outcome")
		}
		if parentRecheckColdSource(&report, early) || report.ColdSource || report.WithinOneSecondProven {
			t.Fatal("later clean trace upgraded known failed coldness")
		}
		growth := parentInvalidationReport{Kind: "growth", EvidenceValid: true, WithinOneSecondProven: true, Classification: "current_before_deadline"}
		if !parentRecheckColdSource(&growth, drained) || !growth.EvidenceValid || !growth.WithinOneSecondProven {
			t.Fatal("replacement coldness changed existing growth qualification")
		}
	})
	t.Run("bounded rearm ordering and current pending identity", func(t *testing.T) {
		at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
		first := cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at, Completed: at}
		makeCalls := func(arms int) []parentNativeCall {
			calls := []parentNativeCall{{API: "warm-attributes", Started: at, Completed: at, BeginSequence: 1, EndSequence: 2}}
			sequence := uint64(4)
			add := func(api string) {
				calls = append(calls, parentNativeCall{API: api, Started: at, Completed: at, BeginSequence: sequence, EndSequence: sequence + 1})
				sequence += 2
			}
			add("notify-wait")
			for i := 0; i < arms; i++ {
				add("notify-rearm")
				add("notify-wait")
			}
			add("first-open")
			calls[len(calls)-1].Selected = &first
			for _, api := range []string{"new-identity", "old-identity", "old-read", "new-read"} {
				add(api)
			}
			return calls
		}
		if !parentHarnessOrdered(makeCalls(2), 3, first, true) {
			t.Fatal("three drained notification batches rejected")
		}
		if parentHarnessOrdered(makeCalls(3), 3, first, true) {
			t.Fatal("fourth notification batch accepted")
		}
		if parentHarnessOrdered(makeCalls(1), 3, first, false) {
			t.Fatal("replacement rearm leaked into growth contract")
		}
		calls := makeCalls(1)
		calls[2].API = "open-watcher"
		if parentHarnessOrdered(calls, 3, first, true) {
			t.Fatal("reopening a watcher path accepted as rearm")
		}
		calls = makeCalls(1)
		calls[len(calls)-4].API = "old-identity"
		calls[len(calls)-3].API = "new-identity"
		if parentHarnessOrdered(calls, 3, first, true) {
			t.Fatal("old handle query preceded first new identity")
		}
		original := parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{1, 3}, Session: 9, FileID: "root", Filter: parentNotifyFilter, Recursive: true}
		next := original
		next.Key.MessageID = 4
		previous := map[parentNotifyKey]bool{original.Key: true}
		pending := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Response: true, Command: wire.ChangeNotify, Connection: 1, SessionID: 9, MessageID: 3, Status: 0x103}
		if _, found, err := parentSelectRearmPending(original, previous, []parentNotifyRequest{original, next}, []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{pending}); err != nil || found {
			t.Fatal("old STATUS_PENDING satisfied rearm")
		}
		pending.MessageID = 4
		if got, found, err := parentSelectRearmPending(original, previous, []parentNotifyRequest{original, next}, []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{pending}); err != nil || !found || got.Key != next.Key {
			t.Fatal("new actual pending rejected")
		}
		pending.SessionID = 10
		if _, found, _ := parentSelectRearmPending(original, previous, []parentNotifyRequest{next}, []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{pending}); found {
			t.Fatal("wrong pending session accepted")
		}
		next.FileID = "other"
		if _, _, err := parentSelectRearmPending(original, previous, []parentNotifyRequest{next}, nil); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("watcher identity changed during rearm")
		}
	})
	t.Run("shrink requires exact new tuple", func(t *testing.T) {
		at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
		q := parentInvalidationQualification{Watched: true, Pending: true, NativeModified: true, WireModified: true, SameConnection: true, Quiet: true, FreshTargetTraffic: true, TraceComplete: true, ACK: at, WriteStarted: at, NotifyCompleted: at.Add(10 * time.Millisecond), FirstExposure: at.Add(-time.Second), EarliestExpiry: at.Add(4 * time.Second), Initial: storage.Attr{ID: 3, Size: 769, MetadataRevision: 2, ModTime: at.Add(-time.Hour)}, Expected: storage.Attr{ID: 3, Size: 73, MetadataRevision: 3, ModTime: at}, Native: cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at.Add(20 * time.Millisecond), Completed: at.Add(30 * time.Millisecond), Size: 73, MTime: cacheGatePositiveTime(at)}}
		if result, ok := parentSizeClassify(q, 769, 73); !ok || result != "current_before_deadline" {
			t.Fatal(result, ok)
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			mutate func(*parentInvalidationQualification)
		}{
			{"wrong EOF", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Native.Size = 257 }},
			{"old mtime", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Native.MTime = cacheGatePositiveTime(q.Initial.ModTime) }},
			{"unchanged revision", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Expected.MetadataRevision = q.Initial.MetadataRevision }},
			{"changed node", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification) { q.Expected.ID++ }},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				changed := q
				test.mutate(&changed)
				if _, ok := parentSizeClassify(changed, 769, 73); ok {
					t.Fatal("wrong shrink tuple accepted")
				}
			})
		}
	})
	t.Run("rename batches retain exact lineage and adjacent pair", func(t *testing.T) {
		original := parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{1, 3}, Session: 9, FileID: "root", Filter: parentNotifyFilter, Recursive: true, Capacity: 4096}
		makeBatches := func() []parentNotifyBatch {
			next := original
			next.Key.MessageID++
			removed := []parentNotifyItem{{2, `v\target`}}
			renamed := []parentNotifyItem{{4, `v\replacement`}, {5, `v\target`}}
			return []parentNotifyBatch{{Pending: original, Native: slices.Clone(removed), Wire: parentNotifyResult{Request: original, Items: slices.Clone(removed)}}, {Pending: next, Native: slices.Clone(renamed), Wire: parentNotifyResult{Request: next, Items: slices.Clone(renamed)}}}
		}
		if complete, valid := parentRenameBatchState(makeBatches(), original); !valid || !complete {
			t.Fatal("complete replacement notifications rejected")
		}
		if complete, valid := parentRenameBatchState(makeBatches()[:1], original); !valid || complete {
			t.Fatal("removed-only prefix is not bounded pending progress")
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			mutate func([]parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch
		}{
			{"consumed pending MID", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch {
				b[1].Pending = b[0].Pending
				b[1].Wire.Request = b[1].Pending
				return b
			}},
			{"different connection", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch {
				b[1].Pending.Key.Connection++
				b[1].Wire.Request = b[1].Pending
				return b
			}},
			{"different session", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch {
				b[1].Pending.Session++
				b[1].Wire.Request = b[1].Pending
				return b
			}},
			{"different watcher", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch {
				b[1].Pending.FileID = "other"
				b[1].Wire.Request = b[1].Pending
				return b
			}},
			{"wrong filter", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch {
				b[1].Pending.Filter = 3
				b[1].Wire.Request = b[1].Pending
				return b
			}},
			{"native wire mismatch", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch { b[1].Wire.Items[1].Name = "other"; return b }},
			{"reversed rename pair", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch {
				slices.Reverse(b[1].Native)
				b[1].Wire.Items = slices.Clone(b[1].Native)
				return b
			}},
			{"split rename pair", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch {
				last := b[1]
				last.Pending.Key.MessageID++
				last.Native = slices.Clone(last.Native[1:])
				last.Wire = parentNotifyResult{Request: last.Pending, Items: slices.Clone(last.Native)}
				b[1].Native = b[1].Native[:1]
				b[1].Wire.Items = b[1].Wire.Items[:1]
				return append(b, last)
			}},
			{"rename before removal", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch { return []parentNotifyBatch{b[1], b[0]} }},
			{"batch bound", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch { return append(b, b...) }},
			{"unexpected modification", func(b []parentNotifyBatch) []parentNotifyBatch {
				b[0].Native[0].Action = 3
				b[0].Wire.Items[0].Action = 3
				return b
			}},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				if complete, valid := parentRenameBatchState(test.mutate(makeBatches()), original); valid || complete {
					t.Fatal("ambiguous rename notifications accepted")
				}
			})
		}
	})
	t.Run("cold replacement source never reaches redirector", func(t *testing.T) {
		at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
		records := []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{
			{At: at, Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, MessageID: 3, Name: "", FileID: "root"},
			{At: at, Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, MessageID: 4, Name: "v", FileID: "child"},
			{At: at, Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Connection: 1, MessageID: 5, Name: `v\target`, FileID: "old"},
			{At: at, Command: wire.QueryInfo, Connection: 1, FileID: "old"},
			{At: at, Command: wire.Read, Connection: 1, FileID: "ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff", RelatedCreate: 5},
		}
		if !parentColdSource(records, at) {
			t.Fatal("known root/v/A and resolved related FileID rejected")
		}
		delayed := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at.Add(time.Millisecond), Response: true, Command: wire.Create, Name: `v\replacement`, Connection: 1, FileID: "B"}
		if parentColdSource(append(slices.Clone(records), delayed), at) {
			t.Fatal("delayed successful B response hid source exposure")
		}
		intervening := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at.Add(time.Millisecond), Command: wire.QueryDirectory, Connection: 1}
		if parentColdSource(append(slices.Clone(records), intervening), at.Add(2*time.Millisecond)) {
			t.Fatal("pre-ACK directory enumeration escaped coldness audit")
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			record cacheGatePositiveWireRecord
		}{
			{"B create", cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Command: wire.Create, Name: `v\replacement`}},
			{"B named info", cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Command: wire.QueryInfo, Name: `v\replacement`, FileID: "old"}},
			{"directory enumeration", cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Command: wire.QueryDirectory}},
			{"unknown read FileID", cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Command: wire.Read, FileID: "unknown"}},
			{"unknown query FileID", cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Command: wire.QueryInfo, FileID: "unknown"}},
			{"unresolved related create", cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Command: wire.QueryInfo, RelatedCreate: 77, FileID: "old"}},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				r := test.record
				r.At = at
				r.Connection = 1
				if parentColdSource(append(slices.Clone(records), r), at) {
					t.Fatal("coldness ambiguity accepted")
				}
			})
		}
	})
	t.Run("relative Windows identity never equals authority numeric IDs", func(t *testing.T) {
		a, b := []byte("A"), []byte("BBB")
		initial := cacheGatePositiveValue{Identity: 3001, Volume: 91, Size: 1}
		current := cacheGatePositiveValue{Identity: 9007, Volume: 91, Size: 3}
		oldRead := cacheGatePositiveValue{Count: 1, Digest: cacheGatePositiveDigest(a)}
		newRead := cacheGatePositiveValue{Count: 3, Digest: cacheGatePositiveDigest(b)}
		if result := parentRelativeIdentity(initial, current, initial, oldRead, newRead, a, b); result != "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes" {
			t.Fatal(result)
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			mutate func(*cacheGatePositiveValue, *cacheGatePositiveValue, *cacheGatePositiveValue, *cacheGatePositiveValue)
		}{
			{"aliased new ID", func(n, o, r, s *cacheGatePositiveValue) { n.Identity = initial.Identity }},
			{"unavailable identity", func(n, o, r, s *cacheGatePositiveValue) { n.Error = "unsupported" }},
			{"zero identity", func(n, o, r, s *cacheGatePositiveValue) { n.Identity = 0 }},
			{"changed old ID", func(n, o, r, s *cacheGatePositiveValue) { o.Identity++ }},
			{"changed volume", func(n, o, r, s *cacheGatePositiveValue) { n.Volume++ }},
			{"wrong old bytes", func(n, o, r, s *cacheGatePositiveValue) { r.Digest = "wrong" }},
			{"wrong new bytes", func(n, o, r, s *cacheGatePositiveValue) { s.Digest = "wrong" }},
			{"wrong handle size", func(n, o, r, s *cacheGatePositiveValue) { n.Size = 1 }},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				n, o, r, s := current, initial, oldRead, newRead
				test.mutate(&n, &o, &r, &s)
				if result := parentRelativeIdentity(initial, n, o, r, s, a, b); result == "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes" {
					t.Fatal("identity or bytes failure became success")
				}
			})
		}
	})
}

func parentTestReplacementQualification(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("replacement qualification preserves deadlines and identity failures", func(t *testing.T) {
		at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
		original := parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{1, 3}, Session: 9, FileID: "root", Filter: parentNotifyFilter, Recursive: true, Capacity: 4096}
		items := []parentNotifyItem{{2, `v\target`}, {4, `v\replacement`}, {5, `v\target`}}
		initial := storage.Attr{ID: 3, Size: 257, MetadataRevision: 2, ModTime: at.Add(-time.Hour)}
		prepared := storage.Attr{ID: 4, Size: 769, MetadataRevision: 3, ModTime: at.Add(-30 * time.Minute)}
		expected := prepared
		expected.MetadataRevision++
		q := parentInvalidationQualification{Watched: true, Pending: true, SameConnection: true, Quiet: true, FreshTargetTraffic: true, TraceComplete: true, ACK: at, WriteStarted: at, NotifyCompleted: at.Add(50 * time.Millisecond), FirstExposure: at.Add(-time.Second), EarliestExpiry: at.Add(4 * time.Second), Initial: initial, Expected: expected, Native: cacheGatePositiveValue{API: "CreateFileW(READ,synchronous)", Started: at.Add(100 * time.Millisecond), Completed: at.Add(150 * time.Millisecond)}}
		observation := cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at.Add(160 * time.Millisecond), Completed: at.Add(170 * time.Millisecond)}
		report := parentInvalidationReport{NotificationMode: parentDetail, PreciseNotificationProven: true, PreparedB: prepared, ColdSource: true, ColdSourceChecked: true, Pending: &original, NotifyBatches: []parentNotifyBatch{{Pending: original, Native: slices.Clone(items), Wire: parentNotifyResult{Request: original, Items: slices.Clone(items), At: at.Add(60 * time.Millisecond)}, Completed: q.NotifyCompleted}}, NewIdentity: observation, RetainedIdentity: observation, RetainedRead: observation, NewRead: observation, IdentityResult: "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes"}
		if result, ok := parentReplacementClassify(q, &report); !ok || result != "current_replacement_identity_before_deadline" {
			t.Fatal(result, ok)
		}
		t.Run("verified rescan preserves all replacement guarantees", func(t *testing.T) {
			makeReport := func(count int) parentInvalidationReport {
				r := report
				r.NotifyBatches = nil
				r.NotificationMode = parentVerifiedRescan
				r.RescanRequired = true
				r.PreciseNotificationProven = false
				r.NotifyOutcomes = nil
				r.Wire = nil
				for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
					request := original
					request.Key.MessageID += uint64(i)
					pending := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at, Connection: request.Key.Connection, SessionID: request.Session, FileID: request.FileID, MessageID: request.Key.MessageID, Command: wire.ChangeNotify, Response: true, Status: 0x103}
					terminal := pending
					terminal.Status = parentStatusNotifyEnum
					terminal.At = at.Add(50 * time.Millisecond)
					completion := parentNativeCompletion{Drained: true, Completed: terminal.At}
					mode := parentVerifiedRescan
					var detail *parentNotifyResult
					if i == 1 {
						terminal.Status = 0
						mode = parentDetail
						completion.Count = 32
						completion.Items = []parentNotifyItem{{4, `v\replacement`}, {5, `v\target`}}
						detail = &parentNotifyResult{Request: request, Items: slices.Clone(completion.Items), At: terminal.At}
					}
					r.NotifyOutcomes = append(r.NotifyOutcomes, parentNotifyOutcome{Mode: mode, Pending: request, Native: completion, Terminal: terminal, Detail: detail})
					r.Wire = append(r.Wire, pending, terminal)
				}
				rearm := original
				rearm.Key.MessageID += uint64(count)
				r.RescanReady = &parentNotifyReadiness{Pending: rearm, Checked: at.Add(80 * time.Millisecond), NativePending: true, EndSequence: 8, ObservationSequence: 20}
				r.FirstObservationSequence = 21
				r.NotifyObservations = []parentNotifyObservation{{Sequence: 19, Record: cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at, Connection: rearm.Key.Connection, SessionID: rearm.Session, FileID: rearm.FileID, MessageID: rearm.Key.MessageID, Command: wire.ChangeNotify, Response: true, Status: 0x103}}}
				r.NativeCalls = []parentNativeCall{{API: "notify-readiness", Started: r.RescanReady.Checked, Completed: r.RescanReady.Checked, BeginSequence: 7, EndSequence: 8}, {API: "first-open", BeginSequence: 9}}
				return r
			}
			for _, count := range []int{1, 2, 3} {
				r := makeReport(count)
				if result, ok := parentReplacementClassify(q, &r); !ok || result != "current_replacement_identity_after_verified_rescan_before_deadline" {
					t.Fatal(count, result, ok)
				}
			}
			for _, test := range []struct {
				name   string
				change func(*parentInvalidationQualification, *parentInvalidationReport)
			}{
				{"four completions", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) { *r = makeReport(4) }},
				{"precise claim after rescan", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
					r.PreciseNotificationProven = true
				}},
				{"mode downgrade", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
					r.NotificationMode = parentDetail
				}},
				{"missing rearm", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) { r.RescanReady = nil }},
				{"late rearm", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
					r.RescanReady.Checked = q.ACK.Add(851 * time.Millisecond)
				}},
				{"unbound readiness", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) { r.RescanReady.EndSequence++ }},
				{"reused pending", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
					r.RescanReady.Pending = r.NotifyOutcomes[0].Pending
				}},
				{"missing wire terminal", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) { r.Wire = r.Wire[:1] }},
				{"unknown cold source", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) { r.ColdSourceChecked = false }},
				{"no new target traffic", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) { q.FreshTargetTraffic = false }},
				{"wrong native identity", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
					r.IdentityResult = "replacement_identity_aliased"
				}},
				{"changed retained bytes", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
					r.IdentityResult = "retained_bytes_changed"
				}},
				{"first api after deadline", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
					q.Native.Completed = q.ACK.Add(time.Second + time.Nanosecond)
				}},
			} {
				t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
					changed, r := q, makeReport(3)
					test.change(&changed, &r)
					if result, ok := parentReplacementClassify(changed, &r); ok {
						t.Fatal("rescan waived replacement proof", result)
					}
				})
			}
		})
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name, want string
			change     func(*parentInvalidationQualification, *parentInvalidationReport)
		}{
			{"warm B", "inconclusive", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) { r.ColdSource = false }},
			{"wrong authoritative node", "inconclusive", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) { q.Expected.ID = q.Initial.ID }},
			{"wrong authoritative size", "inconclusive", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) { q.Expected.Size = 257 }},
			{"wrong B mtime", "inconclusive", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
				q.Expected.ModTime = q.Initial.ModTime
			}},
			{"notification budget reset", "inconclusive", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
				r.NotifyBatches = slices.Clone(r.NotifyBatches)
				r.NotifyBatches[0].Completed = q.ACK.Add(851 * time.Millisecond)
			}},
			{"late immediate identity", "replacement_native_check_deadline_failed", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
				r.NewIdentity.Completed = q.ACK.Add(time.Second + time.Nanosecond)
			}},
			{"identity unavailable", "identity_unavailable", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
				r.IdentityResult = "identity_unavailable"
			}},
			{"identity alias", "replacement_identity_aliased", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
				r.IdentityResult = "replacement_identity_aliased"
			}},
			{"wrong native bytes", "replacement_bytes_wrong", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
				r.IdentityResult = "replacement_bytes_wrong"
			}},
			{"failed first open", "replacement_first_open_failed", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) {
				q.Native.Error = "access denied"
				q.FreshTargetTraffic = false
			}},
			{"no successful refresh", "inconclusive", func(q *parentInvalidationQualification, r *parentInvalidationReport) { q.FreshTargetTraffic = false }},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				changed, copyReport := q, report
				test.change(&changed, &copyReport)
				if result, ok := parentReplacementClassify(changed, &copyReport); ok || result != test.want {
					t.Fatal("replacement verdict changed", result, ok)
				}
			})
		}
	})
}

func parentTestTypedNotify(t *testing.T) {
	at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
	request := parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{1, 8}, Session: 3, FileID: "root", Filter: parentNotifyFilter, Recursive: true, Capacity: parentNotifyLimit, At: at}
	pending := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at, Connection: 1, Response: true, MessageID: 8, SessionID: 3, FileID: "root", Command: wire.ChangeNotify, Status: 0x103}
	terminal := pending
	terminal.Status = parentStatusNotifyEnum
	native := parentNativeCompletion{Drained: true, Completed: at}
	t.Run("cleanup accepts only known completed native statuses", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, err := range []error{nil, syscall.Errno(995), syscall.Errno(parentErrorNotifyEnum)} {
			if !parentCleanupDrained(err) {
				t.Fatal("known completion rejected", err)
			}
		}
		for _, err := range []error{syscall.Errno(996), syscall.Errno(997), syscall.Errno(258), syscall.Errno(5), errors.New("timeout")} {
			if parentCleanupDrained(err) {
				t.Fatal("unknown completion accepted", err)
			}
		}
	})

	t.Run("typed rescan requires matching native and wire terminal", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, code := range []uint32{0, parentErrorNotifyEnum} {
			completion := native
			if code != 0 {
				completion.ErrorCode, completion.Error = code, "ERROR_NOTIFY_ENUM_DIR"
			}
			out, ready, err := parentMatchNotifyOutcome(request, completion, []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{pending, terminal}, nil)
			if err != nil || !ready || out.Mode != parentVerifiedRescan || out.Detail != nil {
				t.Fatal(out, ready, err)
			}
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			change func(*parentNotifyRequest, *parentNativeCompletion, *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord)
		}{
			{"success zero", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				(*w)[1].Status = 0
			}},
			{"notify cleanup", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				(*w)[1].Status = 0x10b
			}},
			{"cancel", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				(*w)[1].Status = 0xc0000120
			}},
			{"native cancellation", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				n.ErrorCode = 995
				n.Error = "aborted"
			}},
			{"undrained timeout", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				n.Drained = false
			}},
			{"invented detail", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				n.Count = 16
				n.Items = []parentNotifyItem{{3, `v\target`}}
			}},
			{"wrong connection", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				(*w)[1].Connection++
			}},
			{"wrong session", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				(*w)[1].SessionID++
			}},
			{"wrong message", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				(*w)[1].MessageID++
			}},
			{"wrong file", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				(*w)[1].FileID = "different"
			}},
			{"missing pending", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				*w = (*w)[1:]
			}},
			{"missing terminal", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				*w = (*w)[:1]
			}},
			{"duplicate terminal", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				*w = append(*w, (*w)[1])
			}},
			{"duplicate pending", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				*w = append(*w, (*w)[0])
			}},
			{"incomplete response", func(r *parentNotifyRequest, n *parentNativeCompletion, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {
				(*w)[1].Incomplete = "truncated"
			}},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				r, n, w := request, native, []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{pending, terminal}
				test.change(&r, &n, &w)
				if out, ready, err := parentMatchNotifyOutcome(r, n, w, nil); err == nil && ready {
					t.Fatal("unverified completion accepted", out)
				}
			})
		}
	})
	t.Run("detail remains exact and separate from rescan", func(t *testing.T) {
		records := []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{pending, terminal}
		records[1].Status = 0
		completion := native
		completion.Count = 32
		completion.Items = []parentNotifyItem{{3, `v\target`}}
		detail := parentNotifyResult{Request: request, Items: slices.Clone(completion.Items), At: at}
		out, ready, err := parentMatchNotifyOutcome(request, completion, records, []parentNotifyResult{detail})
		if err != nil || !ready || out.Mode != parentDetail || out.Detail == nil {
			t.Fatal(out, ready, err)
		}
		detail.Items = []parentNotifyItem{{3, "wrong"}}
		if _, ready, err := parentMatchNotifyOutcome(request, completion, records, []parentNotifyResult{detail}); err == nil && ready {
			t.Fatal("different detail accepted")
		}
	})
	t.Run("bounded rescan call sequence permits drained remainder only", func(t *testing.T) {
		first := cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at, Completed: at}
		callsFor := func(completions int) []parentNativeCall {
			calls := []parentNativeCall{{API: "warm-attributes", Started: at, Completed: at, BeginSequence: 1, EndSequence: 2}}
			sequence := uint64(4)
			add := func(api string) {
				calls = append(calls, parentNativeCall{API: api, Started: at, Completed: at, BeginSequence: sequence, EndSequence: sequence + 1})
				sequence += 2
			}
			for i := 0; i < completions; i++ {
				add("notify-wait")
				add("notify-rearm")
				add("notify-readiness")
			}
			add("first-open")
			calls[len(calls)-1].Selected = &first
			for _, api := range []string{"new-identity", "old-identity", "old-read", "new-read"} {
				add(api)
			}
			return calls
		}
		for _, count := range []int{1, 2, 3} {
			if !parentHarnessOrdered(callsFor(count), 3, first, true) {
				t.Fatal("bounded rescan order rejected", count)
			}
		}
		if parentHarnessOrdered(callsFor(4), 3, first, true) {
			t.Fatal("fourth rescan completion admitted")
		}
		calls := callsFor(1)
		calls[3].API = "target-query"
		if parentHarnessOrdered(calls, 3, first, true) {
			t.Fatal("intervening metadata observation accepted")
		}
		calls = callsFor(1)
		calls[2].API = "open-watcher"
		if parentHarnessOrdered(calls, 3, first, true) {
			t.Fatal("new handle substituted for rearm")
		}
		calls = callsFor(1)
		calls[3].BeginSequence = calls[4].BeginSequence
		if parentHarnessOrdered(calls, 3, first, true) {
			t.Fatal("readiness spanning first API accepted")
		}
	})
	t.Run("checked cold preflight survives a primary notification abort", func(t *testing.T) {
		report := parentInvalidationReport{Kind: "replacement", ColdSourceChecked: true, ColdSource: true, Classification: "inconclusive"}
		if !parentRecheckColdSource(&report, nil) || !report.ColdSourceChecked || !report.ColdSource || report.WithinOneSecondProven {
			t.Fatal("known preflight was erased or promoted")
		}
		report.ColdSourceChecked = false
		if parentRecheckColdSource(&report, nil) {
			t.Fatal("unknown preflight became proof")
		}
	})

	t.Run("readiness uses source order even on identical clocks", func(t *testing.T) {
		rearm := request
		rearm.Key.MessageID++
		current := pending
		current.MessageID++
		ready := parentNotifyReadiness{Pending: rearm, Checked: at, NativePending: true, EndSequence: 8, ObservationSequence: 3}
		report := parentInvalidationReport{Pending: &request, RescanReady: &ready, FirstObservationSequence: 4, NativeCalls: []parentNativeCall{{API: "notify-readiness", Started: at, Completed: at, BeginSequence: 7, EndSequence: 8}, {API: "first-open", BeginSequence: 9}}}
		observations := []parentNotifyObservation{{Sequence: 2, Record: current}}
		if !parentRescanReadinessValid(&report, observations) {
			t.Fatal("current admitted rearm rejected")
		}
		done := current
		done.Status = parentStatusNotifyEnum
		if parentRescanReadinessValid(&report, append(slices.Clone(observations), parentNotifyObservation{Sequence: 3, Record: done})) {
			t.Fatal("pre-first completion accepted at tied clock")
		}
		if !parentRescanReadinessValid(&report, append(slices.Clone(observations), parentNotifyObservation{Sequence: 5, Record: done})) {
			t.Fatal("later activity invalidated earlier readiness")
		}
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name   string
			change func(*parentInvalidationReport, *parentNotifyReadiness, *[]parentNotifyObservation)
		}{
			{"reused request", func(r *parentInvalidationReport, p *parentNotifyReadiness, o *[]parentNotifyObservation) {
				p.Pending = request
			}},
			{"other handle", func(r *parentInvalidationReport, p *parentNotifyReadiness, o *[]parentNotifyObservation) {
				p.Pending.FileID = "other"
			}},
			{"native already complete", func(r *parentInvalidationReport, p *parentNotifyReadiness, o *[]parentNotifyObservation) {
				p.NativePending = false
			}},
			{"terminal already observed", func(r *parentInvalidationReport, p *parentNotifyReadiness, o *[]parentNotifyObservation) {
				p.TerminalObserved = true
			}},
			{"missing pending", func(r *parentInvalidationReport, p *parentNotifyReadiness, o *[]parentNotifyObservation) { *o = nil }},
			{"late pending", func(r *parentInvalidationReport, p *parentNotifyReadiness, o *[]parentNotifyObservation) {
				(*o)[0].Sequence = 4
			}},
			{"missing boundary", func(r *parentInvalidationReport, p *parentNotifyReadiness, o *[]parentNotifyObservation) {
				r.FirstObservationSequence = 0
			}},
			{"reversed ordinal", func(r *parentInvalidationReport, p *parentNotifyReadiness, o *[]parentNotifyObservation) {
				*o = append(*o, (*o)[0])
			}},
		} {
			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				r, p, o := report, ready, slices.Clone(observations)
				r.RescanReady = &p
				test.change(&r, &p, &o)
				if parentRescanReadinessValid(&r, o) {
					t.Fatal("invalid readiness accepted")
				}
			})
		}
	})
}
